diff:
diff --git a/.github/workflows/deploy.yml b/.github/workflows/deploy.yml
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..f63fefe
--- /dev/null
+++ b/.github/workflows/deploy.yml
@@ -0,0 +1,282 @@
+name: Build and Deploy xRL Ingestion Pipeline
+
+# Triggers on push to dev/qa/main, matching this project's existing
+# branch-to-environment convention (see cloudformation/projects/
+# xrl-readiness/params/{dev,qa,prod}.json in the infra repo).
+on:
+  push:
+    branches:
+      - dev
+      - qa
+      - main
+
+env:
+  AWS_REGION: us-east-2
+  ECR_REPOSITORY: lrl-ddcs-ai-xrl-readiness-ecr
+  # Fixed name of the discovery Lambda function -- must match
+  # rDiscoveryLambda's FunctionName in the infra repo's
+  # discovery-lambda.yml exactly (lrl-ddcs-ai-${ProjectCode}-discovery-lambda,
+  # ProjectCode=xrl-readiness). This workflow does NOT create the
+  # function -- see "BOOTSTRAPPING" note below.
+  LAMBDA_FUNCTION_NAME: lrl-ddcs-ai-xrl-readiness-discovery-lambda
+
+jobs:
+  build-and-deploy:
+    name: Build images, push to ECR, update discovery Lambda
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+
+    permissions:
+      id-token: write
+      contents: read
+
+    steps:
+      - name: Checkout Code
+        uses: actions/checkout@v4
+
+      - name: Generate Version Tags
+        id: version
+        run: |
+          # One timestamp, two tags -- same build, two ECR entries, one
+          # per service. Prefix scheme chosen specifically so that a
+          # future second Batch-style service or a future second
+          # Lambda-style service can be added later without changing
+          # this format -- each new service gets its own prefix, and the
+          # infra repo's "find latest tag for MY service" lookup (see
+          # infra repo's deploy.yml) only ever matches its own prefix,
+          # never a different service's tag that happens to be newer.
+          TIMESTAMP=$(date -u '+%Y%m%d%H%M%S')
+          SHORT_SHA=${GITHUB_SHA::8}
+          BATCH_TAG="xrl-ingestion-${TIMESTAMP}-${SHORT_SHA}"
+          LAMBDA_TAG="xrl-sharepoint-discovery-${TIMESTAMP}-${SHORT_SHA}"
+          echo "BATCH_TAG=${BATCH_TAG}" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
+          echo "LAMBDA_TAG=${LAMBDA_TAG}" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
+          echo "Batch image tag:  ${BATCH_TAG}"
+          echo "Lambda image tag: ${LAMBDA_TAG}"
+
+      - name: Set Environment-Specific Variables
+        run: |
+          # Same branch -> account mapping already used throughout this
+          # project's infra repo workflows.
+          if [[ "${GITHUB_REF##*/}" == "dev" ]]; then
+            echo "ENV_NAME=dev" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
+            echo "AWS_ACCOUNT_ID=${{ vars.AWS_ACCOUNT_ID_DEV }}" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
+          elif [[ "${GITHUB_REF##*/}" == "qa" ]]; then
+            echo "ENV_NAME=qa" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
+            echo "AWS_ACCOUNT_ID=${{ vars.AWS_ACCOUNT_ID_QA }}" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
+          elif [[ "${GITHUB_REF##*/}" == "main" ]]; then
+            echo "ENV_NAME=prod" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
+            echo "AWS_ACCOUNT_ID=${{ vars.AWS_ACCOUNT_ID_PROD }}" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
+          else
+            echo "No environment mapping for branch ${GITHUB_REF##*/} -- exiting."
+            exit 1
+          fi
+
+      # Strip whitespace from DEPLOYMENT_ROLE before use -- NEW, added to
+      # match the infra repo's own deploy.yml, which does this exact
+      # `tr -d '[:space:]'` strip on this exact org variable in three
+      # separate places, consistently. That's not stylistic -- a
+      # consistent defensive pattern applied to the same one variable,
+      # every time it's used, across a whole other repo strongly implies
+      # a real, previously-hit problem (a trailing newline/space in this
+      # variable's stored value silently producing a malformed
+      # role-to-assume ARN, which would fail sts:AssumeRole with a
+      # confusing "role not found"-style error rather than a clear
+      # whitespace complaint). This workflow references the SAME org
+      # variable (vars.DEPLOYMENT_ROLE), so whatever justified that
+      # pattern there applies equally here -- not applying it was an
+      # inconsistency between the two repos' otherwise-parallel
+      # workflows, not a considered difference.
+      - name: Sanitize Deployment Role
+        run: echo "DEPLOYMENT_ROLE=$(echo '${{ vars.DEPLOYMENT_ROLE }}' | tr -d '[:space:]')" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
+
+      - name: Configure AWS Credentials
+        uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@v4
+        with:
+          role-to-assume: arn:aws:iam::${{ env.AWS_ACCOUNT_ID }}:role/${{ env.DEPLOYMENT_ROLE }}
+          aws-region: ${{ env.AWS_REGION }}
+
+      - name: Log In to ECR
+        run: |
+          aws ecr get-login-password --region ${{ env.AWS_REGION }} \
+            | docker login --username AWS --password-stdin \
+              ${{ env.AWS_ACCOUNT_ID }}.dkr.ecr.${{ env.AWS_REGION }}.amazonaws.com/${{ env.ECR_REPOSITORY }}
+
+      # --- Artifactory login -- NEW. Required because both Dockerfiles'
+      # pip install now goes through Lilly's internal Artifactory PyPI
+      # proxy (elilillyco.jfrog.io), not public PyPI directly -- see
+      # processing/Dockerfile and discovery/sharepoint/Dockerfile's own
+      # RUN --mount=type=secret steps for the actual install command.
+      # Same reusable composite action already used for this in this
+      # org's other repos (the ECS-deployed autogen-report pipeline).
+      - name: Artifactory login
+        uses: EliLillyCo/.github/actions/artifactory-login@main
+
+      # --- Export the three JF_ARTIFACTORY_* org secrets into this job's
+      # environment -- NEW, and NOT redundant with the login step above.
+      # CORRECTED after an earlier version of this workflow wrongly
+      # assumed the login step alone made these values available to
+      # `docker build --secret id=...` below. Verified against GitHub's
+      # own docs, stated twice in almost identical wording: "GitHub
+      # Actions can only read a secret if you explicitly include the
+      # secret in a workflow" and "To make a secret available to an
+      # action, you must set the secret as an input or environment
+      # variable in your workflow file." Composite actions specifically
+      # (this one is invoked via `uses:` under `steps:`, not a reusable
+      # workflow's job-level `uses:`) have no `secrets: inherit`
+      # mechanism at all (confirmed against actions/toolkit#1168) -- a
+      # composite action cannot silently pull org secrets just by being
+      # called, regardless of what the login step itself does
+      # internally. This step is the one place these three secrets are
+      # ever referenced via ${{ secrets.* }} in this whole workflow --
+      # without it, every `--secret id=JF_ARTIFACTORY_*` flag below binds
+      # to nothing (Docker's own documented default: a bare
+      # `--secret id=NAME` reads from a same-named shell env var, which
+      # would not exist without this step), and the build fails with a
+      # clear "secret not found" error, not a silent wrong-credential
+      # failure.
+      - name: Export Artifactory Secrets
+        run: |
+          echo "JF_ARTIFACTORY_EMAIL=${{ secrets.JF_ARTIFACTORY_EMAIL }}" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
+          echo "JF_ARTIFACTORY_TOKEN=${{ secrets.JF_ARTIFACTORY_TOKEN }}" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
+          echo "JF_ARTIFACTORY_AUTH=${{ secrets.JF_ARTIFACTORY_AUTH }}" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
+
+      # --- Batch image: fetch/expand/process, via processing/Dockerfile ---
+      # -f gives the location; the trailing "." keeps the build
+      # CONTEXT at repo root (unchanged) -- shared/ is a real
+      # cross-cutting dependency both images COPY from, so narrowing the
+      # context to processing/ would make it unreachable. See
+      # processing/Dockerfile's own header for the full reasoning.
+      #
+      # DOCKER_BUILDKIT: 1 and --secret id=... -- NEW, both required
+      # together for the same reason: processing/Dockerfile's pip
+      # install step uses `RUN --mount=type=secret,id=...`, a BuildKit-
+      # only feature (confirmed against Docker's own BuildKit secrets
+      # documentation and multiple independent sources -- not available
+      # under the legacy builder at all, not just recommended). Without
+      # DOCKER_BUILDKIT: 1, this docker build would either fail outright
+      # or silently fall back to a builder that doesn't understand
+      # --mount=type=secret, depending on the installed Docker version.
+      # The three secret ids (JF_ARTIFACTORY_EMAIL/TOKEN/AUTH) must match
+      # exactly what processing/Dockerfile's RUN step expects to read
+      # from /run/secrets/ -- see that file for the exact ids -- AND
+      # must match the env var names the "Export Artifactory Secrets"
+      # step above just set, since that's what a bare --secret id=NAME
+      # (no src=/env= suffix) binds to by Docker's own documented
+      # default.
+      - name: Build Batch Image
+        env:
+          DOCKER_BUILDKIT: 1
+        run: |
+          docker build \
+            --secret id=JF_ARTIFACTORY_EMAIL \
+            --secret id=JF_ARTIFACTORY_TOKEN \
+            --secret id=JF_ARTIFACTORY_AUTH \
+            -f processing/Dockerfile \
+            -t ${{ env.AWS_ACCOUNT_ID }}.dkr.ecr.${{ env.AWS_REGION }}.amazonaws.com/${{ env.ECR_REPOSITORY }}:${{ env.BATCH_TAG }} \
+            .
+
+      - name: Push Batch Image
+        run: |
+          docker push ${{ env.AWS_ACCOUNT_ID }}.dkr.ecr.${{ env.AWS_REGION }}.amazonaws.com/${{ env.ECR_REPOSITORY }}:${{ env.BATCH_TAG }}
+
+      # --- Lambda image: discovery, via discovery/sharepoint/Dockerfile ---
+      # Same DOCKER_BUILDKIT/--secret requirement as the Batch image
+      # above, same reasoning -- discovery/sharepoint/Dockerfile's pip
+      # install step also uses RUN --mount=type=secret.
+      - name: Build Discovery Lambda Image
+        env:
+          DOCKER_BUILDKIT: 1
+        run: |
+          docker build \
+            --secret id=JF_ARTIFACTORY_EMAIL \
+            --secret id=JF_ARTIFACTORY_TOKEN \
+            --secret id=JF_ARTIFACTORY_AUTH \
+            -f discovery/sharepoint/Dockerfile \
+            -t ${{ env.AWS_ACCOUNT_ID }}.dkr.ecr.${{ env.AWS_REGION }}.amazonaws.com/${{ env.ECR_REPOSITORY }}:${{ env.LAMBDA_TAG }} \
+            .
+
+      - name: Push Discovery Lambda Image
+        run: |
+          docker push ${{ env.AWS_ACCOUNT_ID }}.dkr.ecr.${{ env.AWS_REGION }}.amazonaws.com/${{ env.ECR_REPOSITORY }}:${{ env.LAMBDA_TAG }}
+
+      # --- Update the discovery Lambda directly (Path 1 -- see
+      # INGESTION_ARCHITECTURE.md / this project's deployment design
+      # discussion for why this is safe alongside the infra repo's own
+      # separate lookup. CONFIRMED, not just designed: as of the infra
+      # repo's own deploy.yml, its "Check discovery-lambda image exists
+      # in ECR" step queries ECR directly for the newest
+      # xrl-sharepoint-discovery-* tag by push time and passes it as
+      # LambdaImageTag whenever discovery-lambda.yml is deployed -- this
+      # step and that lookup always converge on the same image, they
+      # never disagree. That infra-side lookup matters most for the
+      # Lambda's FIRST-EVER creation (before this step has ever run,
+      # there's no existing function for update-function-code to
+      # target) and as a drift-corrector on any later infra redeploy if
+      # this step ever failed silently. ---
+      - name: Update Discovery Lambda Function Code
+        run: |
+          # Existence guard -- matches the pattern this project's design
+          # is based on (autogen's data-processing-pipelines repo,
+          # build-scripts/docker.sh). The Lambda function itself is
+          # created once by the infra repo's discovery-lambda.yml
+          # (BOOTSTRAPPING, see below) -- this step only ever UPDATES an
+          # already-existing function. If it doesn't exist yet, skip
+          # gracefully rather than fail the whole workflow; the infra
+          # repo needs to create it first.
+          #
+          # FIXED -- error-message check added. Previously checked ONLY
+          # the exit code of `aws lambda get-function` (stderr discarded
+          # via 2>&1 >/dev/null), which meant a genuine problem -- most
+          # concretely, the deployment role's IAM permissions no longer
+          # including lambda:GetFunction (currently granted via the
+          # org-wide federated-roles-policy.yml, outside this repo's own
+          # control, so not guaranteed to stay that way) -- would produce
+          # the exact same non-zero exit code as "function doesn't exist
+          # yet", and get silently reported as the reassuring, expected
+          # first-deploy message instead of a real failure. Matches AWS's
+          # own documented pattern for this exact distinction (see their
+          # boto3 GetFunction example: catch ResourceNotFoundException
+          # specifically, re-raise everything else) -- captures stderr,
+          # checks for that specific error name, and only takes the
+          # "doesn't exist yet, skip" path when it's actually present.
+          # Any other error (permissions, throttling, a malformed
+          # function name) now correctly fails this step instead of
+          # being misreported as benign.
+          GET_FN_OUTPUT=$(aws lambda get-function --function-name "${{ env.LAMBDA_FUNCTION_NAME }}" 2>&1)
+          GET_FN_EXIT=$?
+          if [ $GET_FN_EXIT -eq 0 ]; then
+            aws lambda update-function-code \
+              --function-name "${{ env.LAMBDA_FUNCTION_NAME }}" \
+              --image-uri ${{ env.AWS_ACCOUNT_ID }}.dkr.ecr.${{ env.AWS_REGION }}.amazonaws.com/${{ env.ECR_REPOSITORY }}:${{ env.LAMBDA_TAG }}
+            echo "Updated ${{ env.LAMBDA_FUNCTION_NAME }} to image tag ${{ env.LAMBDA_TAG }}."
+          elif echo "$GET_FN_OUTPUT" | grep -q "ResourceNotFoundException"; then
+            echo "Lambda function ${{ env.LAMBDA_FUNCTION_NAME }} does not exist yet."
+            echo "This is expected on a first-ever deploy -- the infra repo's"
+            echo "discovery-lambda.yml must be deployed at least once before this"
+            echo "step can update it. Skipping (not failing this workflow)."
+          else
+            echo "::error::aws lambda get-function failed for a reason OTHER than"
+            echo "::error::the function not existing yet -- NOT treating this as the"
+            echo "::error::expected first-deploy case. Failing this step so the real"
+            echo "::error::problem (permissions, throttling, region mismatch, etc.)"
+            echo "::error::gets investigated rather than silently skipped."
+            echo "$GET_FN_OUTPUT"
+            exit $GET_FN_EXIT
+          fi
+
+      # --- Reminder: Batch job definitions are NOT updated by this
+      # workflow -- see this project's deployment design discussion
+      # ("Option B"). CONFIRMED, not just designed: the infra repo's
+      # own deploy.yml now has a "Find newest Batch image tag in ECR"
+      # step that queries for the newest xrl-ingestion-* tag by push
+      # time and passes it as batch.yml's ImageTag parameter -- no
+      # manual tag entry is needed on that side, only a manual TRIGGER
+      # of that workflow. Simple log line only, per that discussion --
+      # not a failure, not a GitHub annotation. ---
+      - name: Reminder - Batch job definitions require a separate infra deploy
+        run: |
+          echo "Image pushed: ${{ env.BATCH_TAG }}"
+          echo "This tag is NOT yet live in AWS Batch (fetch/expand/process)."
+          echo "Trigger the infra repo's deploy workflow to pick it up -- it"
+          echo "automatically finds and deploys the newest xrl-ingestion-*"
+          echo "tag in ECR by push time, so no manual tag entry is needed."
label: CT1
label_reason: New GHA workflow assumes an AWS deployment IAM role and updates a production Lambda function's code/ECR images, going beyond a pure Artifactory-only change so it fails the CT3 'no extra modifications' and 'no additional risk' conditions.

diff:
diff --git a/.github/workflows/deploy.yml b/.github/workflows/deploy.yml
index f63fefe..fe0b232 100644
--- a/.github/workflows/deploy.yml
+++ b/.github/workflows/deploy.yml
@@ -242,8 +242,38 @@ jobs:
           # Any other error (permissions, throttling, a malformed
           # function name) now correctly fails this step instead of
           # being misreported as benign.
+          #
+          # BUG FOUND AND FIXED IN THIS FIX ITSELF -- errexit (bash -e,
+          # which every GitHub Actions `run:` step uses, confirmed in
+          # this step's own logged `shell: /usr/bin/bash -e {0}` line)
+          # treats `VAR=$(cmd)` as a single simple command whose exit
+          # status is the command's own exit status -- confirmed
+          # against real bash behavior, not assumed: `set -e;
+          # foo=$(false)` genuinely aborts the script right there,
+          # silently, before the very next line (even GET_FN_EXIT=$?)
+          # ever runs. First deployed version of this fix hit exactly
+          # this: aws lambda get-function failed, the assignment line
+          # itself triggered -e, and the script died with NO output at
+          # all -- not even reaching the echo "$GET_FN_OUTPUT" line
+          # meant to show the real error, and never reaching the
+          # elif/else logic meant to distinguish ResourceNotFoundException
+          # from a real problem. Confirmed via a minimal local repro
+          # before writing this fix, not guessed. FIXED by temporarily
+          # suspending errexit (set +e / set -e) around just this one
+          # assignment -- the standard pattern for "capture a command's
+          # real exit status without letting a non-zero result abort
+          # the script outright" under errexit. Deliberately NOT using
+          # `|| true` inside the substitution instead -- that makes the
+          # SUBSTITUTION's own exit status always 0, which would have
+          # silently defeated GET_FN_EXIT's whole purpose (confirmed via
+          # the same local repro: `|| true` stops the abort but also
+          # zeroes out the real exit code, which is not what's needed
+          # here since the elif/else below depends on knowing whether
+          # get-function genuinely succeeded or failed).
+          set +e
           GET_FN_OUTPUT=$(aws lambda get-function --function-name "${{ env.LAMBDA_FUNCTION_NAME }}" 2>&1)
           GET_FN_EXIT=$?
+          set -e
           if [ $GET_FN_EXIT -eq 0 ]; then
             aws lambda update-function-code \
               --function-name "${{ env.LAMBDA_FUNCTION_NAME }}" \
@@ -279,4 +309,4 @@ jobs:
           echo "This tag is NOT yet live in AWS Batch (fetch/expand/process)."
           echo "Trigger the infra repo's deploy workflow to pick it up -- it"
           echo "automatically finds and deploys the newest xrl-ingestion-*"
-          echo "tag in ECR by push time, so no manual tag entry is needed."
+          echo "tag in ECR by push time, so no manual tag entry is needed."
\ No newline at end of file
label: CT2
label_reason: Pure bash errexit bug fix (set +e/set -e) to existing deploy logic with no change to permissions, access, or data flow.

@@ -0,0 +1,998 @@
+%YAML 1.1
+---
+AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
+
+Parameters:
+  ServiceName:
+    Type: String
+    Default: lusa-lilly-com-webapp
+    Description: The name of the ECS service.
+  ECRRepoName:
+    Type: String
+    Description: The name of the ECR service.
+  DeployEnvironment:
+    Type: String
+    AllowedValues:
+      - dev
+      - qa
+      - prod
+  DomainName:
+    Type: String
+    Description: Domain name for app
+  HostedZoneId:
+    Type: String
+    Description: Route 53 Hosted Zone ID for domain name
+  PublicSecurityGroupType:
+    Type: String
+    Description: Where is incoming traffic allowed to come from?
+    AllowedValues:
+      - LillyNetworkHttpAccess
+      - PublicHttpAccess
+  CostCenter:
+    Type: String
+    Description: ID of the cost center for this application
+  CostCenterApprover:
+    Type: String
+    Description: System ID of the cost center approver
+  SystemOwner:
+    Type: String
+    Description: System ID of the system owner
+  SystemCustodian:
+    Type: String
+    Description: System ID of the system custodian
+  PrimaryItContact:
+    Type: String
+    Description: System ID of the primary IT contact
+  Level1BusinessArea:
+    Type: String
+  DataClassification:
+    Type: String
+    AllowedValues:
+      - Green
+      - Yellow
+      - Orange
+      - Red
+      - TBD
+  Hipaa:
+    Type: String
+    AllowedValues:
+      - "Yes"
+      - "No"
+      - TBD
+    Description: Is app subject to HIPAA?
+  PublicSubnets:
+    Type: CommaDelimitedList
+  PrivateSubnets:
+    Type: CommaDelimitedList
+  ContainerCpu:
+    Type: Number
+    Default: 256
+    Description: How much CPU to give the container. 1024 is 1 CPU.
+  ContainerMemory:
+    Type: Number
+    Default: 512
+    Description: How much memory in megabytes to give the container.
+  ContainerPort:
+    Type: Number
+    Description: Which port to map from the task's container.
+  InitialTaskCount:
+    Type: Number
+    Default: 1
+    Description: How many tasks should the service initially start?
+  MaxTaskCount:
+    Type: Number
+    Default: 5
+    Description: How many tasks should autoscaling scale out to at most?
+  HealthCheckIntervalSeconds:
+    Type: Number
+    Default: 30
+    Description: The number of seconds between load balancer health checks on targets.
+  HealthCheckPath:
+    Type: String
+    Default: /
+    Description: The path the load balancer should use to check target health.
+  CPUScalingPercentage:
+    Type: Number
+    Default: 50
+    Description: Scale out when CPU utilization reaches this percentage.
+  RequestsPerMinuteScaling:
+    Type: Number
+    Default: 1000
+    Description: Scale out/in as number of requests per minute goes above/below this value.
+
+Conditions:
+  IsPublic:
+    Fn::Equals:
+      - !Ref PublicSecurityGroupType
+      - PublicHttpAccess
+
+Resources:
+  Cluster:
+    Type: AWS::ECS::Cluster
+    Properties:
+      Tags:
+        - Key: ProjectName
+          Value: !Ref ServiceName
+        - Key: Environment
+          Value: !Ref DeployEnvironment
+        - Key: CostCenter
+          Value: !Ref CostCenter
+        - Key: CostCenterApprover
+          Value: !Ref CostCenterApprover
+        - Key: SystemOwner
+          Value: !Ref SystemOwner
+        - Key: SystemCustodian
+          Value: !Ref SystemCustodian
+        - Key: PrimaryItContact
+          Value: !Ref PrimaryItContact
+        - Key: Level1BusinessArea
+          Value: !Ref Level1BusinessArea
+        - Key: DataClassification
+          Value: !Ref DataClassification
+        - Key: Hipaa
+          Value: !Ref Hipaa
+
+  ECSTaskExecutionRole:
+    # Enables the task's container to perform actions. Here, it allows:
+    #   - CloudWatch logs to be created and written to
+    #   - Read access to the SSM parameters for the app
+    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
+    Properties:
+      PermissionsBoundary: !Sub arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:policy/LZ-IAM-Boundary
+      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
+        Statement:
+          - Effect: Allow
+            Principal:
+              Service:
+                - ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
+            Action:
+              - sts:AssumeRole
+      Path: /
+      Policies:
+        - PolicyName: AmazonECSTaskExecutionRolePolicy
+          PolicyDocument:
+            Statement:
+              - Effect: Allow
+                Action:
+                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
+                  - logs:CreateLogStream
+                  - logs:PutLogEvents
+                  - ecr:*
+                Resource: "*"
+              - Effect: Allow
+                Action:
+                  - ssm:GetParameters
+                Resource: !Sub arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/${ServiceName}/*
+      Tags:
+        - Key: ProjectName
+          Value: !Ref ServiceName
+        - Key: Environment
+          Value: !Ref DeployEnvironment
+        - Key: CostCenter
+          Value: !Ref CostCenter
+        - Key: CostCenterApprover
+          Value: !Ref CostCenterApprover
+        - Key: SystemOwner
+          Value: !Ref SystemOwner
+        - Key: SystemCustodian
+          Value: !Ref SystemCustodian
+        - Key: PrimaryItContact
+          Value: !Ref PrimaryItContact
+        - Key: Level1BusinessArea
+          Value: !Ref Level1BusinessArea
+        - Key: DataClassification
+          Value: !Ref DataClassification
+        - Key: Hipaa
+          Value: !Ref Hipaa
+
+  ECSTaskRole:
+    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
+    Properties:
+      PermissionsBoundary: !Sub arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:policy/LZ-IAM-Boundary
+      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
+        Statement:
+          - Effect: Allow
+            Principal:
+              Service:
+                - ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
+            Action:
+              - sts:AssumeRole
+      Policies:
+        - PolicyName: AmazonECSTaskExecutionRolePolicy
+          PolicyDocument:
+            Statement:
+              - Effect: Allow
+                Action:
+                  - xray:PutTraceSegments
+                  - xray:PutTelemetryRecords
+                  - xray:GetSamplingRules
+                  - xray:GetSamplingTargets
+                  - xray:GetSamplingStatisticSummaries
+                Resource: "*"
+      Tags:
+        - Key: ProjectName
+          Value: !Ref ServiceName
+        - Key: Environment
+          Value: !Ref DeployEnvironment
+        - Key: CostCenter
+          Value: !Ref CostCenter
+        - Key: CostCenterApprover
+          Value: !Ref CostCenterApprover
+        - Key: SystemOwner
+          Value: !Ref SystemOwner
+        - Key: SystemCustodian
+          Value: !Ref SystemCustodian
+        - Key: PrimaryItContact
+          Value: !Ref PrimaryItContact
+        - Key: Level1BusinessArea
+          Value: !Ref Level1BusinessArea
+        - Key: DataClassification
+          Value: !Ref DataClassification
+        - Key: Hipaa
+          Value: !Ref Hipaa
+
+  WebTaskDefinition:
+    # Main "web" task
+    # Defines a task with the CPU, memory, and container image values passed in
+    # via parameters.
+    Type: AWS::ECS::TaskDefinition
+    Properties:
+      Family: !Ref ServiceName
+      Cpu: !Ref ContainerCpu
+      Memory: !Ref ContainerMemory
+      NetworkMode: awsvpc
+      RequiresCompatibilities:
+        - FARGATE
+      ContainerDefinitions:
+        - Name: !Ref ServiceName
+          Image:
+            !Join
+            - ""
+            - - !Ref AWS::AccountId
+              - .dkr.ecr.
+              - !Ref AWS::Region
+              - .amazonaws.com/
+              - !Ref ECRRepoName
+              - ":"
+              - IMAGE_TAG_PLACEHOLDER
+          PortMappings:
+            - ContainerPort: !Ref ContainerPort
+          LogConfiguration:
+            LogDriver: awslogs
+            Options:
+              awslogs-create-group: "true"
+              awslogs-region: !Ref AWS::Region
+              awslogs-group:
+                !Join
+                - ""
+                - - /aws/ecs/
+                  - !Ref Cluster
+              awslogs-stream-prefix: !Ref ServiceName
+          Environment:
+            - Name: NODE_ENV
+              Value: production
+            - Name: HOST
+              Value: !Ref DomainName
+          Secrets:
+            - Name: AUTH_STATE_CRYPTO_SECRET
+              ValueFrom: !Sub arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/${ServiceName}/AUTH_STATE_CRYPTO_SECRET
+            - Name: CONTENTFUL_ACCESS_TOKEN
+              ValueFrom: !Sub arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/${ServiceName}/CONTENTFUL_ACCESS_TOKEN
+            - Name: CONTENTFUL_ENABLED
+              ValueFrom: !Sub arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/${ServiceName}/CONTENTFUL_ENABLED
+            - Name: CONTENTFUL_ENVIRONMENT
+              ValueFrom: !Sub arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/${ServiceName}/CONTENTFUL_ENVIRONMENT
+            - Name: CONTENTFUL_LOCALE
+              ValueFrom: !Sub arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/${ServiceName}/CONTENTFUL_LOCALE
+            - Name: CONTENTFUL_SPACE_ID
+              ValueFrom: !Sub arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/${ServiceName}/CONTENTFUL_SPACE_ID
+            - Name: CONTENTFUL_HOST
+              ValueFrom: !Sub arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/${ServiceName}/CONTENTFUL_HOST
+            - Name: COOKIE_SIGN_KEY
+              ValueFrom: !Sub arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/${ServiceName}/COOKIE_SIGN_KEY
+            - Name: CSP_ENABLED
+              ValueFrom: !Sub arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/${ServiceName}/CSP_ENABLED
+            - Name: CSP_SKIP_BROWSER
+              ValueFrom: !Sub arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/${ServiceName}/CSP_SKIP_BROWSER
+            - Name: HELMET_CONTENTFUL_TOKEN
+              ValueFrom: !Sub arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/${ServiceName}/HELMET_CONTENTFUL_TOKEN
+            - Name: JF_ARTIFACTORY_AUTH
+              ValueFrom: !Sub arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/${ServiceName}/JF_ARTIFACTORY_AUTH
+            - Name: LKM_AZURE_AUTH_URL
+              ValueFrom: !Sub arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/${ServiceName}/LKM_AZURE_AUTH_URL
+            - Name: LKM_AZURE_CLIENTID
+              ValueFrom: !Sub arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/${ServiceName}/LKM_AZURE_CLIENTID
+            - Name: LKM_AZURE_CLIENT_SECRET
+              ValueFrom: !Sub arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/${ServiceName}/LKM_AZURE_CLIENT_SECRET
+            - Name: LKM_AZURE_GRANT_TYPE
+              ValueFrom: !Sub arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/${ServiceName}/LKM_AZURE_GRANT_TYPE
+            - Name: LKM_AZURE_SCOPE
+              ValueFrom: !Sub arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/${ServiceName}/LKM_AZURE_SCOPE
+            - Name: LKM_CLIENT_CERTIFICATE
+              ValueFrom: !Sub arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/${ServiceName}/LKM_CLIENT_CERTIFICATE
+            - Name: LKM_CLIENT_KEY
+              ValueFrom: !Sub arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/${ServiceName}/LKM_CLIENT_KEY
+            - Name: LKM_CLIENT_PASSPHRASE
+              ValueFrom: !Sub arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/${ServiceName}/LKM_CLIENT_PASSPHRASE
+            - Name: LKM_LANDINGZONE_ACCOUNTID
+              ValueFrom: !Sub arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/${ServiceName}/LKM_LANDINGZONE_ACCOUNTID
+            - Name: NODE_MODULES_CACHE
+              ValueFrom: !Sub arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/${ServiceName}/NODE_MODULES_CACHE
+            - Name: PREPROD_AUTH_CONNECTION
+              ValueFrom: !Sub arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/${ServiceName}/PREPROD_AUTH_CONNECTION
+            - Name: PREPROD_AUTH_ENABLED
+              ValueFrom: !Sub arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/${ServiceName}/PREPROD_AUTH_ENABLED
+            - Name: PREPROD_AUTH_CALLBACK_URL
+              ValueFrom: !Sub arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/${ServiceName}/PREPROD_AUTH_CALLBACK_URL
+            - Name: APP_BASE
+              ValueFrom: !Sub arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/${ServiceName}/APP_BASE
+      ExecutionRoleArn: !GetAtt ECSTaskExecutionRole.Arn
+      TaskRoleArn: !GetAtt ECSTaskRole.Arn
+      Tags:
+        - Key: ProjectName
+          Value: !Ref ServiceName
+        - Key: Environment
+          Value: !Ref DeployEnvironment
+        - Key: CostCenter
+          Value: !Ref CostCenter
+        - Key: CostCenterApprover
+          Value: !Ref CostCenterApprover
+        - Key: SystemOwner
+          Value: !Ref SystemOwner
+        - Key: SystemCustodian
+          Value: !Ref SystemCustodian
+        - Key: PrimaryItContact
+          Value: !Ref PrimaryItContact
+        - Key: Level1BusinessArea
+          Value: !Ref Level1BusinessArea
+        - Key: DataClassification
+          Value: !Ref DataClassification
+        - Key: Hipaa
+          Value: !Ref Hipaa
+
+  Service:
+    Type: AWS::ECS::Service
+    DependsOn:
+      - LoadBalancerHttpRule
+      - LoadBalancerHttpsRule
+    Properties:
+      ServiceName: !Ref ServiceName
+      Cluster: !Ref Cluster
+      LaunchType: FARGATE
+      DeploymentConfiguration:
+        DeploymentCircuitBreaker:
+          Enable: true
+          Rollback: true
+        MaximumPercent: 200
+        MinimumHealthyPercent: 75
+      DesiredCount: !Ref InitialTaskCount
+      NetworkConfiguration:
+        AwsvpcConfiguration:
+          AssignPublicIp: DISABLED
+          SecurityGroups:
+            - !Ref FargateContainerSecurityGroup
+          Subnets: !Ref PrivateSubnets
+      TaskDefinition: !Ref WebTaskDefinition
+      LoadBalancers:
+        - ContainerName: !Ref ServiceName
+          ContainerPort: !Ref ContainerPort
+          TargetGroupArn: !Ref TargetGroup
+      PropagateTags: SERVICE
+      Tags:
+        - Key: ProjectName
+          Value: !Ref ServiceName
+        - Key: Environment
+          Value: !Ref DeployEnvironment
+        - Key: CostCenter
+          Value: !Ref CostCenter
+        - Key: CostCenterApprover
+          Value: !Ref CostCenterApprover
+        - Key: SystemOwner
+          Value: !Ref SystemOwner
+        - Key: SystemCustodian
+          Value: !Ref SystemCustodian
+        - Key: PrimaryItContact
+          Value: !Ref PrimaryItContact
+        - Key: Level1BusinessArea
+          Value: !Ref Level1BusinessArea
+        - Key: DataClassification
+          Value: !Ref DataClassification
+        - Key: Hipaa
+          Value: !Ref Hipaa
+
+  FargateContainerSecurityGroup:
+    # A security group for the containers we will run in Fargate.
+    # Two rules, allowing network traffic from a public facing load
+    # balancer, and from other members of the security group.
+    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
+    Properties:
+      GroupDescription: Access to the Fargate containers
+      VpcId: !ImportValue DefaultVPC
+      Tags:
+        - Key: ProjectName
+          Value: !Ref ServiceName
+        - Key: Environment
+          Value: !Ref DeployEnvironment
+        - Key: CostCenter
+          Value: !Ref CostCenter
+        - Key: CostCenterApprover
+          Value: !Ref CostCenterApprover
+        - Key: SystemOwner
+          Value: !Ref SystemOwner
+        - Key: SystemCustodian
+          Value: !Ref SystemCustodian
+        - Key: PrimaryItContact
+          Value: !Ref PrimaryItContact
+        - Key: Level1BusinessArea
+          Value: !Ref Level1BusinessArea
+        - Key: DataClassification
+          Value: !Ref DataClassification
+        - Key: Hipaa
+          Value: !Ref Hipaa
+
+  PublicSecurityGroup:
+    # Use this group to allow app access from the public internet
+    Type: Custom::LillySecurityGroup
+    Properties:
+      ServiceToken: !ImportValue RVM-LambdaARN
+      DefinitionName: PublicHttpAccess
+      VpcId: !ImportValue DefaultVPC
+      Tags:
+        ProjectName: !Ref ServiceName
+        SystemCustodian: !Ref SystemCustodian
+        SystemOwner: !Ref SystemOwner
+        PrimaryItContact: !Ref PrimaryItContact
+        CostCenter: !Ref CostCenter
+        CostCenterApprover: !Ref CostCenterApprover
+        Level1BusinessArea: !Ref Level1BusinessArea
+        DataClassification: !Ref DataClassification
+        Hipaa: !Ref Hipaa
+
+  LillyNetworkSecurityGroup:
+    # Use this group to allow app access from the Lilly Network (40.0.0.0/10)
+    Type: Custom::LillySecurityGroup
+    Properties:
+      ServiceToken: !ImportValue RVM-LambdaARN
+      DefinitionName: LillyNetworkHttpAccess
+      VpcId: !ImportValue DefaultVPC
+      Tags:
+        ProjectName: !Ref ServiceName
+        SystemCustodian: !Ref SystemCustodian
+        SystemOwner: !Ref SystemOwner
+        PrimaryItContact: !Ref PrimaryItContact
+        CostCenter: !Ref CostCenter
+        CostCenterApprover: !Ref CostCenterApprover
+        Level1BusinessArea: !Ref Level1BusinessArea
+        DataClassification: !Ref DataClassification
+        Hipaa: !Ref Hipaa
+
+  PublicLoadBalancerSG:
+    # A public facing load balancer, this is used for accepting traffic from the public
+    # internet and directing it to public facing microservices
+    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
+    Properties:
+      GroupDescription: Access to the public facing load balancer
+      VpcId: !ImportValue DefaultVPC
+      Tags:
+        - Key: ProjectName
+          Value: !Ref ServiceName
+        - Key: Environment
+          Value: !Ref DeployEnvironment
+        - Key: CostCenter
+          Value: !Ref CostCenter
+        - Key: CostCenterApprover
+          Value: !Ref CostCenterApprover
+        - Key: SystemOwner
+          Value: !Ref SystemOwner
+        - Key: SystemCustodian
+          Value: !Ref SystemCustodian
+        - Key: PrimaryItContact
+          Value: !Ref PrimaryItContact
+        - Key: Level1BusinessArea
+          Value: !Ref Level1BusinessArea
+        - Key: DataClassification
+          Value: !Ref DataClassification
+        - Key: Hipaa
+          Value: !Ref Hipaa
+
+  EcsSecurityGroupIngressFromSelf:
+    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupIngress
+    Properties:
+      Description: Ingress from other containers in the same security group
+      GroupId: !Ref FargateContainerSecurityGroup
+      IpProtocol: "-1"
+      SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref FargateContainerSecurityGroup
+
+  EcsSecurityGroupIngressFromPublicALB:
+    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupIngress
+    Properties:
+      Description: Ingress from the public ALB
+      GroupId: !Ref FargateContainerSecurityGroup
+      IpProtocol: "-1"
+      SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref PublicLoadBalancerSG
+
+  PublicLoadBalancerIngressFromSelf:
+    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupIngress
+    Properties:
+      Description: Allows communcation between security group members
+      GroupId: !Ref PublicLoadBalancerSG
+      IpProtocol: "-1"
+      SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref PublicLoadBalancerSG
+
+  PublicLoadBalancer:
+    # The load balancer is placed into the public subnets, so that traffic
+    # from the internet can reach the load balancer directly via the internet
+    # gateway
+    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::LoadBalancer
+    Properties:
+      Scheme: internet-facing
+      LoadBalancerAttributes:
+        - Key: idle_timeout.timeout_seconds
+          Value: "30"
+      Subnets: !Ref PublicSubnets
+      SecurityGroups:
+        - !Ref PublicLoadBalancerSG
+        - Fn::If:
+            - IsPublic
+            - !GetAtt PublicSecurityGroup.GroupId
+            - !GetAtt LillyNetworkSecurityGroup.GroupId
+      Tags:
+        - Key: ProjectName
+          Value: !Ref ServiceName
+        - Key: Environment
+          Value: !Ref DeployEnvironment
+        - Key: CostCenter
+          Value: !Ref CostCenter
+        - Key: CostCenterApprover
+          Value: !Ref CostCenterApprover
+        - Key: SystemOwner
+          Value: !Ref SystemOwner
+        - Key: SystemCustodian
+          Value: !Ref SystemCustodian
+        - Key: PrimaryItContact
+          Value: !Ref PrimaryItContact
+        - Key: Level1BusinessArea
+          Value: !Ref Level1BusinessArea
+        - Key: DataClassification
+          Value: !Ref DataClassification
+        - Key: Hipaa
+          Value: !Ref Hipaa
+
+  TargetGroup:
+    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::TargetGroup
+    Properties:
+      HealthCheckIntervalSeconds: !Ref HealthCheckIntervalSeconds
+      HealthCheckPath: !Ref HealthCheckPath
+      HealthCheckProtocol: HTTP
+      HealthCheckTimeoutSeconds: 5
+      HealthyThresholdCount: 2
+      Matcher:
+        HttpCode: 200,302,301
+      TargetType: ip
+      Port: !Ref ContainerPort
+      Protocol: HTTP
+      VpcId: !ImportValue DefaultVPC
+      Tags:
+        - Key: ProjectName
+          Value: !Ref ServiceName
+        - Key: Environment
+          Value: !Ref DeployEnvironment
+        - Key: CostCenter
+          Value: !Ref CostCenter
+        - Key: CostCenterApprover
+          Value: !Ref CostCenterApprover
+        - Key: SystemOwner
+          Value: !Ref SystemOwner
+        - Key: SystemCustodian
+          Value: !Ref SystemCustodian
+        - Key: PrimaryItContact
+          Value: !Ref PrimaryItContact
+        - Key: Level1BusinessArea
+          Value: !Ref Level1BusinessArea
+        - Key: DataClassification
+          Value: !Ref DataClassification
+        - Key: Hipaa
+          Value: !Ref Hipaa
+
+  PublicLoadBalancerHttpListener:
+    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::Listener
+    Properties:
+      DefaultActions:
+        - TargetGroupArn: !Ref TargetGroup
+          Type: forward
+      LoadBalancerArn: !Ref PublicLoadBalancer
+      Port: 80
+      Protocol: HTTP
+
+  PublicLoadBalancerHttpsListener:
+    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::Listener
+    Properties:
+      Certificates:
+        - CertificateArn: !Ref HttpsCertificate
+      DefaultActions:
+        - TargetGroupArn: !Ref TargetGroup
+          Type: forward
+      LoadBalancerArn: !Ref PublicLoadBalancer
+      Port: 443
+      Protocol: HTTPS
+
+  LoadBalancerHttpRule:
+    # Creates a rule on the load balancer for routing HTTP traffic to the target group
+    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::ListenerRule
+    Properties:
+      Actions:
+        - TargetGroupArn: !Ref TargetGroup
+          Type: forward
+      Conditions:
+        - Field: path-pattern
+          Values:
+            - "*"
+      ListenerArn: !Ref PublicLoadBalancerHttpListener
+      Priority: 1
+
+  LoadBalancerHttpsRule:
+    # Creates a rule on the load balancer for routing HTTPS traffic to the target group
+    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::ListenerRule
+    Properties:
+      Actions:
+        - TargetGroupArn: !Ref TargetGroup
+          Type: forward
+      Conditions:
+        - Field: path-pattern
+          Values:
+            - "*"
+      ListenerArn: !Ref PublicLoadBalancerHttpsListener
+      Priority: 1
+
+  PublicLoadBalancerRecordSet:
+    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
+    Properties:
+      AliasTarget:
+        DNSName: !GetAtt PublicLoadBalancer.DNSName
+        HostedZoneId: !GetAtt PublicLoadBalancer.CanonicalHostedZoneID
+      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZoneId
+      Name: !Ref DomainName
+      Type: A
+
+  HttpsCertificate:
+    Type: AWS::CertificateManager::Certificate
+    Properties:
+      DomainName: !Ref DomainName
+      DomainValidationOptions:
+        - DomainName: !Ref DomainName
+          HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZoneId
+      ValidationMethod: DNS
+      Tags:
+        - Key: ProjectName
+          Value: !Ref ServiceName
+        - Key: Environment
+          Value: !Ref DeployEnvironment
+        - Key: CostCenter
+          Value: !Ref CostCenter
+        - Key: CostCenterApprover
+          Value: !Ref CostCenterApprover
+        - Key: SystemOwner
+          Value: !Ref SystemOwner
+        - Key: SystemCustodian
+          Value: !Ref SystemCustodian
+        - Key: PrimaryItContact
+          Value: !Ref PrimaryItContact
+        - Key: Level1BusinessArea
+          Value: !Ref Level1BusinessArea
+        - Key: DataClassification
+          Value: !Ref DataClassification
+        - Key: Hipaa
+          Value: !Ref Hipaa
+
+  AutoScalingRole:
+    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
+    Properties:
+      PermissionsBoundary: !Sub arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:policy/LZ-IAM-Boundary
+      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
+        Version: "2012-10-17"
+        Statement:
+          - Effect: Allow
+            Principal:
+              Service:
+                - application-autoscaling.amazonaws.com
+            Action:
+              - sts:AssumeRole
+      Policies:
+        - PolicyName: AutoScalingRolePolicy
+          PolicyDocument:
+            Version: "2012-10-17"
+            Statement:
+              - Effect: Allow
+                Action:
+                  - application-autoscaling:*
+                  - ecs:RunTask
+                  - ecs:UpdateService
+                  - ecs:DescribeServices
+                  - cloudwatch:PutMetricAlarm
+                  - cloudwatch:DescribeAlarms
+                  - cloudwatch:GetMetricStatistics
+                  - cloudwatch:SetAlarmState
+                  - cloudwatch:DeleteAlarms
+                Resource: "*"
+      Tags:
+        - Key: ProjectName
+          Value: !Ref ServiceName
+        - Key: Environment
+          Value: !Ref DeployEnvironment
+        - Key: CostCenter
+          Value: !Ref CostCenter
+        - Key: CostCenterApprover
+          Value: !Ref CostCenterApprover
+        - Key: SystemOwner
+          Value: !Ref SystemOwner
+        - Key: SystemCustodian
+          Value: !Ref SystemCustodian
+        - Key: PrimaryItContact
+          Value: !Ref PrimaryItContact
+        - Key: Level1BusinessArea
+          Value: !Ref Level1BusinessArea
+        - Key: DataClassification
+          Value: !Ref DataClassification
+        - Key: Hipaa
+          Value: !Ref Hipaa
+
+  AutoScalingTarget:
+    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
+    DependsOn: Service
+    Properties:
+      MaxCapacity: !Ref MaxTaskCount
+      MinCapacity: 0
+      ResourceId:
+        !Join
+        - /
+        - - service
+          - !Ref Cluster
+          - !Ref ServiceName
+      RoleARN: !GetAtt AutoScalingRole.Arn
+      ScalableDimension: ecs:service:DesiredCount
+      ServiceNamespace: ecs
+
+  CPUAutoScalingPolicy:
+    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
+    Properties:
+      PolicyName: CPUAutoScalingPolicy
+      PolicyType: TargetTrackingScaling
+      ScalingTargetId: !Ref AutoScalingTarget

+          Value: !Ref PrimaryItContact
+        - Key: Level1BusinessArea

+        - Key: DataClassification
+          Value: !Ref DataClassification
+        - Key: Hipaa
+          Value: !Ref Hipaa
+
+  Service:
+    Type: AWS::ECS::Service
+    DependsOn:
+      - LoadBalancerHttpsRule
+    Properties:
+      ServiceName: !Ref ServiceName
+      Cluster:
+        Fn::ImportValue:
+          Fn::Sub: ${ParentStack}-ClusterName
+      LaunchType: FARGATE
+      DeploymentConfiguration:
+        DeploymentCircuitBreaker:
+          Enable: true
+          Rollback: true
+        MaximumPercent: 200
+        MinimumHealthyPercent: 75
+      DesiredCount: !Ref InitialTaskCount
+      NetworkConfiguration:
+        AwsvpcConfiguration:
+          AssignPublicIp: DISABLED
+          SecurityGroups:
+            - Fn::ImportValue: !Sub ${ParentStack}-FargateContainerSecurityGroup
+          Subnets: !Ref PrivateSubnets
+      TaskDefinition: !Ref WebTaskDefinition
+      LoadBalancers:
+        - ContainerName: !Ref ServiceName
+          ContainerPort: !Ref ContainerPort
+          TargetGroupArn: !Ref TargetGroup
+      PropagateTags: SERVICE
+      Tags:
+        - Key: ProjectName
+          Value: !Ref ServiceName
+        - Key: Environment
+          Value: !Ref DeployEnvironment
+        - Key: CostCenter
+          Value: !Ref CostCenter
+        - Key: CostCenterApprover
+          Value: !Ref CostCenterApprover
+        - Key: SystemOwner
+          Value: !Ref SystemOwner
+        - Key: SystemCustodian
+          Value: !Ref SystemCustodian
+        - Key: PrimaryItContact

+        - Key: Level1BusinessArea

+        - Key: Hipaa

+      TargetType: ip
+      Port: !Ref ContainerPort
+      Protocol: HTTP
+      VpcId: !ImportValue DefaultVPC
+      Tags:
+        - Key: ProjectName
+          Value: !Ref ServiceName
+        - Key: Environment
+          Value: !Ref DeployEnvironment
+        - Key: CostCenter
+          Value: !Ref CostCenter
+        - Key: CostCenterApprover
+          Value: !Ref CostCenterApprover
+        - Key: SystemOwner
+          Value: !Ref SystemOwner
+        - Key: SystemCustodian
+          Value: !Ref SystemCustodian
+        - Key: PrimaryItContact
+          Value: !Ref PrimaryItContact
+        - Key: Level1BusinessArea
+          Value: !Ref Level1BusinessArea

+            Protocol: HTTPS
+            Query: ""
+            StatusCode: HTTP_302
+          Type: redirect
+      Conditions:
+        - Field: path-pattern
+          Values:

+      Priority: 19

+            Action:
+              - sts:AssumeRole
+      Policies:
+        - PolicyName: AutoScalingRolePolicy

+                  - ecs:RunTask

+                  - ecs:DescribeServices
+                  - cloudwatch:PutMetricAlarm
+                  - cloudwatch:DescribeAlarms
+                  - cloudwatch:GetMetricStatistics
+                  - cloudwatch:SetAlarmState
+                  - cloudwatch:DeleteAlarms
+                Resource: "*"

+        - Key: ProjectName
+          Value: !Ref ServiceName
+        - Key: Environment
+          Value: !Ref DeployEnvironment
+        - Key: CostCenter
+          Value: !Ref CostCenter
+        - Key: CostCenterApprover
+          Value: !Ref CostCenterApprover
+        - Key: SystemOwner
+          Value: !Ref SystemOwner
+        - Key: SystemCustodian
+          Value: !Ref SystemCustodian
+        - Key: PrimaryItContact
+          Value: !Ref PrimaryItContact
+        - Key: Level1BusinessArea
+          Value: !Ref Level1BusinessArea
+        - Key: DataClassification
+          Value: !Ref DataClassification
+        - Key: Hipaa
+          Value: !Ref Hipaa

+      MinCapacity: 0

+        - - service

+          - !Ref ServiceName
+      RoleARN: !GetAtt AutoScalingRole.Arn
+      ScalableDimension: ecs:service:DesiredCount
+      ServiceNamespace: ecs
+
+  
+
+  CPUAutoScalingPolicy:
+    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
+    Properties:

+      ScalingTargetId: !Ref AutoScalingTarget
+      StepScalingPolicyConfiguration:

+        Cooldown: 60
+        MetricAggregationType: Average

+            ScalingAdjustment: 1
+          - MetricIntervalUpperBound: 0
+            ScalingAdjustment: -1
+

+    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm

+      Namespace: AWS/ApplicationELB
+      Statistic: Sum
+      Period: 60
+      EvaluationPeriods: 1
+      Threshold: !Ref RequestsPerMinuteScaling
+      AlarmActions:
+        - !Ref RequestsAutoScalingPolicy
+      OKActions:
+        - !Ref RequestsAutoScalingPolicy
+      Dimensions:
+        - Name: TargetGroup

+      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold

+              - ecs:ListTaskDefinitions
+              - ecs:ListTasks
+              - ecs:RunTask
+              - ecs:StartTask
+              - ecs:StopTask
+              - ecs:UpdateService
+            Resource: "*"
+          - Effect: Allow
+            Action:
+              - codepipeline:RetryStageExecution
+            Resource: "*"
+          - Effect: Allow
+            Action:
+              - elasticloadbalancing:ModifyRule
+            Resource:
+              - !Ref LoadBalancerHttpsRule
+          - Effect: Allow
+            Action:
+              - iam:PassRole
+            Resource:
+              - !GetAtt ECSTaskExecutionRole.Arn
+              - !GetAtt ECSTaskRole.Arn
+      Roles:
+        - !Ref AdminRole
+
+Outputs:
+  ServiceName:
+    Value: !Ref Service
+  ImageTag:
+    Value: IMAGE_TAG_PLACEHOLDER
