@@ -0,0 +1,996 @@
+%YAML 1.1
+---
+AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
+
+Parameters:
+  ServiceName:
+    Type: String
+    Default: lusa-lilly-com-webapp
+    Description: The name of the ECS service.
+  ECRRepoName:
+    Type: String
+    Description: The name of the ECR service.
+  DeployEnvironment:
+    Type: String
+    AllowedValues:
+      - dev
+      - qa
+      - prod
+  DomainName:
+    Type: String
+    Description: Domain name for app
+  HostedZoneId:
+    Type: String
+    Description: Route 53 Hosted Zone ID for domain name
+  PublicSecurityGroupType:
+    Type: String
+    Description: Where is incoming traffic allowed to come from?
+    AllowedValues:
+      - LillyNetworkHttpAccess
+      - PublicHttpAccess
+  CostCenter:
+    Type: String
+    Description: ID of the cost center for this application
+  CostCenterApprover:
+    Type: String
+    Description: System ID of the cost center approver
+  SystemOwner:
+    Type: String
+    Description: System ID of the system owner
+  SystemCustodian:
+    Type: String
+    Description: System ID of the system custodian
+  PrimaryItContact:
+    Type: String
+    Description: System ID of the primary IT contact
+  Level1BusinessArea:
+    Type: String
+  DataClassification:
+    Type: String
+    AllowedValues:
+      - Green
+      - Yellow
+      - Orange
+      - Red
+      - TBD
+  Hipaa:
+    Type: String
+    AllowedValues:
+      - "Yes"
+      - "No"
+      - TBD
+    Description: Is app subject to HIPAA?
+  PublicSubnets:
+    Type: CommaDelimitedList
+  PrivateSubnets:
+    Type: CommaDelimitedList
+  ContainerCpu:
+    Type: Number
+    Default: 256
+    Description: How much CPU to give the container. 1024 is 1 CPU.
+  ContainerMemory:
+    Type: Number
+    Default: 512
+    Description: How much memory in megabytes to give the container.
+  ContainerPort:
+    Type: Number
+    Description: Which port to map from the task's container.
+  InitialTaskCount:
+    Type: Number
+    Default: 1
+    Description: How many tasks should the service initially start?
+  MaxTaskCount:
+    Type: Number
+    Default: 5
+    Description: How many tasks should autoscaling scale out to at most?
+  HealthCheckIntervalSeconds:
+    Type: Number
+    Default: 30
+    Description: The number of seconds between load balancer health checks on targets.
+  HealthCheckPath:
+    Type: String
+    Default: /
+    Description: The path the load balancer should use to check target health.
+  CPUScalingPercentage:
+    Type: Number
+    Default: 50
+    Description: Scale out when CPU utilization reaches this percentage.
+  RequestsPerMinuteScaling:
+    Type: Number
+    Default: 1000
+    Description: Scale out/in as number of requests per minute goes above/below this value.
+
+Conditions:
+  IsPublic:
+    Fn::Equals:
+      - !Ref PublicSecurityGroupType
+      - PublicHttpAccess
+
+Resources:
+  Cluster:
+    Type: AWS::ECS::Cluster
+    Properties:
+      Tags:
+        - Key: ProjectName
+          Value: !Ref ServiceName
+        - Key: Environment
+          Value: !Ref DeployEnvironment
+        - Key: CostCenter
+          Value: !Ref CostCenter
+        - Key: CostCenterApprover
+          Value: !Ref CostCenterApprover
+        - Key: SystemOwner
+          Value: !Ref SystemOwner
+        - Key: SystemCustodian
+          Value: !Ref SystemCustodian
+        - Key: PrimaryItContact
+          Value: !Ref PrimaryItContact
+        - Key: Level1BusinessArea
+          Value: !Ref Level1BusinessArea
+        - Key: DataClassification
+          Value: !Ref DataClassification
+        - Key: Hipaa
+          Value: !Ref Hipaa
+
+  ECSTaskExecutionRole:
+    # Enables the task's container to perform actions. Here, it allows:
+    #   - CloudWatch logs to be created and written to
+    #   - Read access to the SSM parameters for the app
+    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
+    Properties:
+      PermissionsBoundary: !Sub arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:policy/LZ-IAM-Boundary
+      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
+        Statement:
+          - Effect: Allow
+            Principal:
+              Service:
+                - ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
+            Action:
+              - sts:AssumeRole
+      Path: /
+      Policies:
+        - PolicyName: AmazonECSTaskExecutionRolePolicy
+          PolicyDocument:
+            Statement:
+              - Effect: Allow
+                Action:
+                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
+                  - logs:CreateLogStream
+                  - logs:PutLogEvents
+                  - ecr:*
+                Resource: "*"
+              - Effect: Allow
+                Action:
+                  - ssm:GetParameters
+                Resource: !Sub arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/${ServiceName}/*
+      Tags:
+        - Key: ProjectName
+          Value: !Ref ServiceName
+        - Key: Environment
+          Value: !Ref DeployEnvironment
+        - Key: CostCenter
+          Value: !Ref CostCenter
+        - Key: CostCenterApprover
+          Value: !Ref CostCenterApprover
+        - Key: SystemOwner
+          Value: !Ref SystemOwner
+        - Key: SystemCustodian
+          Value: !Ref SystemCustodian
+        - Key: PrimaryItContact
+          Value: !Ref PrimaryItContact
+        - Key: Level1BusinessArea
+          Value: !Ref Level1BusinessArea
+        - Key: DataClassification
+          Value: !Ref DataClassification
+        - Key: Hipaa
+          Value: !Ref Hipaa
+
+  ECSTaskRole:
+    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
+    Properties:
+      PermissionsBoundary: !Sub arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:policy/LZ-IAM-Boundary
+      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
+        Statement:
+          - Effect: Allow
+            Principal:
+              Service:
+                - ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
+            Action:
+              - sts:AssumeRole
+      Policies:
+        - PolicyName: AmazonECSTaskExecutionRolePolicy
+          PolicyDocument:
+            Statement:
+              - Effect: Allow
+                Action:
+                  - xray:PutTraceSegments
+                  - xray:PutTelemetryRecords
+                  - xray:GetSamplingRules
+                  - xray:GetSamplingTargets
+                  - xray:GetSamplingStatisticSummaries
+                Resource: "*"
+      Tags:
+        - Key: ProjectName
+          Value: !Ref ServiceName
+        - Key: Environment
+          Value: !Ref DeployEnvironment
+        - Key: CostCenter
+          Value: !Ref CostCenter
+        - Key: CostCenterApprover
+          Value: !Ref CostCenterApprover
+        - Key: SystemOwner
+          Value: !Ref SystemOwner
+        - Key: SystemCustodian
+          Value: !Ref SystemCustodian
+        - Key: PrimaryItContact
+          Value: !Ref PrimaryItContact
+        - Key: Level1BusinessArea
+          Value: !Ref Level1BusinessArea
+        - Key: DataClassification
+          Value: !Ref DataClassification
+        - Key: Hipaa
+          Value: !Ref Hipaa
+
+  WebTaskDefinition:
+    # Main "web" task
+    # Defines a task with the CPU, memory, and container image values passed in
+    # via parameters.
+    Type: AWS::ECS::TaskDefinition
+    Properties:
+      Family: !Ref ServiceName
+      Cpu: !Ref ContainerCpu
+      Memory: !Ref ContainerMemory
+      NetworkMode: awsvpc
+      RequiresCompatibilities:
+        - FARGATE
+      ContainerDefinitions:
+        - Name: !Ref ServiceName
+          Image:
+            !Join
+            - ""
+            - - !Ref AWS::AccountId
+              - .dkr.ecr.
+              - !Ref AWS::Region
+              - .amazonaws.com/
+              - !Ref ECRRepoName
+              - ":"
+              - IMAGE_TAG_PLACEHOLDER
+          PortMappings:
+            - ContainerPort: !Ref ContainerPort
+          LogConfiguration:
+            LogDriver: awslogs
+            Options:
+              awslogs-create-group: "true"
+              awslogs-region: !Ref AWS::Region
+              awslogs-group:
+                !Join
+                - ""
+                - - /aws/ecs/
+                  - !Ref Cluster
+              awslogs-stream-prefix: !Ref ServiceName
+          Environment:
+            - Name: NODE_ENV
+              Value: production
+            - Name: HOST
+              Value: !Ref DomainName
+          Secrets:
+            - Name: AUTH_STATE_CRYPTO_SECRET
+              ValueFrom: !Sub arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/${ServiceName}/AUTH_STATE_CRYPTO_SECRET
+            - Name: CONTENTFUL_ACCESS_TOKEN
+              ValueFrom: !Sub arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/${ServiceName}/CONTENTFUL_ACCESS_TOKEN
+            - Name: CONTENTFUL_ENABLED
+              ValueFrom: !Sub arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/${ServiceName}/CONTENTFUL_ENABLED
+            - Name: CONTENTFUL_ENVIRONMENT
+              ValueFrom: !Sub arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/${ServiceName}/CONTENTFUL_ENVIRONMENT
+            - Name: CONTENTFUL_LOCALE
+              ValueFrom: !Sub arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/${ServiceName}/CONTENTFUL_LOCALE
+            - Name: CONTENTFUL_SPACE_ID
+              ValueFrom: !Sub arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/${ServiceName}/CONTENTFUL_SPACE_ID
+            - Name: COOKIE_SIGN_KEY
+              ValueFrom: !Sub arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/${ServiceName}/COOKIE_SIGN_KEY
+            - Name: CSP_ENABLED
+              ValueFrom: !Sub arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/${ServiceName}/CSP_ENABLED
+            - Name: CSP_SKIP_BROWSER
+              ValueFrom: !Sub arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/${ServiceName}/CSP_SKIP_BROWSER
+            - Name: HELMET_CONTENTFUL_TOKEN
+              ValueFrom: !Sub arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/${ServiceName}/HELMET_CONTENTFUL_TOKEN
+            - Name: JF_ARTIFACTORY_AUTH
+              ValueFrom: !Sub arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/${ServiceName}/JF_ARTIFACTORY_AUTH
+            - Name: LKM_AZURE_AUTH_URL
+              ValueFrom: !Sub arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/${ServiceName}/LKM_AZURE_AUTH_URL
+            - Name: LKM_AZURE_CLIENTID
+              ValueFrom: !Sub arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/${ServiceName}/LKM_AZURE_CLIENTID
+            - Name: LKM_AZURE_CLIENT_SECRET
+              ValueFrom: !Sub arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/${ServiceName}/LKM_AZURE_CLIENT_SECRET
+            - Name: LKM_AZURE_GRANT_TYPE
+              ValueFrom: !Sub arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/${ServiceName}/LKM_AZURE_GRANT_TYPE
+            - Name: LKM_AZURE_SCOPE
+              ValueFrom: !Sub arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/${ServiceName}/LKM_AZURE_SCOPE
+            - Name: LKM_CLIENT_CERTIFICATE
+              ValueFrom: !Sub arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/${ServiceName}/LKM_CLIENT_CERTIFICATE
+            - Name: LKM_CLIENT_KEY
+              ValueFrom: !Sub arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/${ServiceName}/LKM_CLIENT_KEY
+            - Name: LKM_CLIENT_PASSPHRASE
+              ValueFrom: !Sub arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/${ServiceName}/LKM_CLIENT_PASSPHRASE
+            - Name: LKM_LANDINGZONE_ACCOUNTID
+              ValueFrom: !Sub arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/${ServiceName}/LKM_LANDINGZONE_ACCOUNTID
+            - Name: NODE_MODULES_CACHE
+              ValueFrom: !Sub arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/${ServiceName}/NODE_MODULES_CACHE
+            - Name: PREPROD_AUTH_CONNECTION
+              ValueFrom: !Sub arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/${ServiceName}/PREPROD_AUTH_CONNECTION
+            - Name: PREPROD_AUTH_ENABLED
+              ValueFrom: !Sub arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/${ServiceName}/PREPROD_AUTH_ENABLED
+            - Name: PREPROD_AUTH_CALLBACK_URL
+              ValueFrom: !Sub arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/${ServiceName}/PREPROD_AUTH_CALLBACK_URL
+            - Name: APP_BASE
+              ValueFrom: !Sub arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/${ServiceName}/APP_BASE
+      ExecutionRoleArn: !GetAtt ECSTaskExecutionRole.Arn
+      TaskRoleArn: !GetAtt ECSTaskRole.Arn
+      Tags:
+        - Key: ProjectName
+          Value: !Ref ServiceName
+        - Key: Environment
+          Value: !Ref DeployEnvironment
+        - Key: CostCenter
+          Value: !Ref CostCenter
+        - Key: CostCenterApprover
+          Value: !Ref CostCenterApprover
+        - Key: SystemOwner
+          Value: !Ref SystemOwner
+        - Key: SystemCustodian
+          Value: !Ref SystemCustodian
+        - Key: PrimaryItContact
+          Value: !Ref PrimaryItContact
+        - Key: Level1BusinessArea
+          Value: !Ref Level1BusinessArea
+        - Key: DataClassification
+          Value: !Ref DataClassification
+        - Key: Hipaa
+          Value: !Ref Hipaa
+
+  Service:
+    Type: AWS::ECS::Service
+    DependsOn:
+      - LoadBalancerHttpRule
+      - LoadBalancerHttpsRule
+    Properties:
+      ServiceName: !Ref ServiceName
+      Cluster: !Ref Cluster
+      LaunchType: FARGATE
+      DeploymentConfiguration:
+        DeploymentCircuitBreaker:
+          Enable: true
+          Rollback: true
+        MaximumPercent: 200
+        MinimumHealthyPercent: 75
+      DesiredCount: !Ref InitialTaskCount
+      NetworkConfiguration:
+        AwsvpcConfiguration:
+          AssignPublicIp: DISABLED
+          SecurityGroups:
+            - !Ref FargateContainerSecurityGroup
+          Subnets: !Ref PrivateSubnets
+      TaskDefinition: !Ref WebTaskDefinition
+      LoadBalancers:
+        - ContainerName: !Ref ServiceName
+          ContainerPort: !Ref ContainerPort
+          TargetGroupArn: !Ref TargetGroup
+      PropagateTags: SERVICE
+      Tags:
+        - Key: ProjectName
+          Value: !Ref ServiceName
+        - Key: Environment
+          Value: !Ref DeployEnvironment
+        - Key: CostCenter
+          Value: !Ref CostCenter
+        - Key: CostCenterApprover
+          Value: !Ref CostCenterApprover
+        - Key: SystemOwner
+          Value: !Ref SystemOwner
+        - Key: SystemCustodian
+          Value: !Ref SystemCustodian
+        - Key: PrimaryItContact
+          Value: !Ref PrimaryItContact
+        - Key: Level1BusinessArea
+          Value: !Ref Level1BusinessArea
+        - Key: DataClassification
+          Value: !Ref DataClassification
+        - Key: Hipaa
+          Value: !Ref Hipaa
+
+  FargateContainerSecurityGroup:
+    # A security group for the containers we will run in Fargate.
+    # Two rules, allowing network traffic from a public facing load
+    # balancer, and from other members of the security group.
+    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
+    Properties:
+      GroupDescription: Access to the Fargate containers
+      VpcId: !ImportValue DefaultVPC
+      Tags:
+        - Key: ProjectName
+          Value: !Ref ServiceName
+        - Key: Environment
+          Value: !Ref DeployEnvironment
+        - Key: CostCenter
+          Value: !Ref CostCenter
+        - Key: CostCenterApprover
+          Value: !Ref CostCenterApprover
+        - Key: SystemOwner
+          Value: !Ref SystemOwner
+        - Key: SystemCustodian
+          Value: !Ref SystemCustodian
+        - Key: PrimaryItContact
+          Value: !Ref PrimaryItContact
+        - Key: Level1BusinessArea
+          Value: !Ref Level1BusinessArea
+        - Key: DataClassification
+          Value: !Ref DataClassification
+        - Key: Hipaa
+          Value: !Ref Hipaa
+
+  PublicSecurityGroup:
+    # Use this group to allow app access from the public internet
+    Type: Custom::LillySecurityGroup
+    Properties:
+      ServiceToken: !ImportValue RVM-LambdaARN
+      DefinitionName: PublicHttpAccess
+      VpcId: !ImportValue DefaultVPC
+      Tags:
+        ProjectName: !Ref ServiceName
+        SystemCustodian: !Ref SystemCustodian
+        SystemOwner: !Ref SystemOwner
+        PrimaryItContact: !Ref PrimaryItContact
+        CostCenter: !Ref CostCenter
+        CostCenterApprover: !Ref CostCenterApprover
+        Level1BusinessArea: !Ref Level1BusinessArea
+        DataClassification: !Ref DataClassification
+        Hipaa: !Ref Hipaa
+
+  LillyNetworkSecurityGroup:
+    # Use this group to allow app access from the Lilly Network (40.0.0.0/10)
+    Type: Custom::LillySecurityGroup
+    Properties:
+      ServiceToken: !ImportValue RVM-LambdaARN
+      DefinitionName: LillyNetworkHttpAccess
+      VpcId: !ImportValue DefaultVPC
+      Tags:
+        ProjectName: !Ref ServiceName
+        SystemCustodian: !Ref SystemCustodian
+        SystemOwner: !Ref SystemOwner
+        PrimaryItContact: !Ref PrimaryItContact
+        CostCenter: !Ref CostCenter
+        CostCenterApprover: !Ref CostCenterApprover
+        Level1BusinessArea: !Ref Level1BusinessArea
+        DataClassification: !Ref DataClassification
+        Hipaa: !Ref Hipaa
+
+  PublicLoadBalancerSG:
+    # A public facing load balancer, this is used for accepting traffic from the public
+    # internet and directing it to public facing microservices
+    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
+    Properties:
+      GroupDescription: Access to the public facing load balancer
+      VpcId: !ImportValue DefaultVPC
+      Tags:
+        - Key: ProjectName
+          Value: !Ref ServiceName
+        - Key: Environment
+          Value: !Ref DeployEnvironment
+        - Key: CostCenter
+          Value: !Ref CostCenter
+        - Key: CostCenterApprover
+          Value: !Ref CostCenterApprover
+        - Key: SystemOwner
+          Value: !Ref SystemOwner
+        - Key: SystemCustodian
+          Value: !Ref SystemCustodian
+        - Key: PrimaryItContact
+          Value: !Ref PrimaryItContact
+        - Key: Level1BusinessArea
+          Value: !Ref Level1BusinessArea
+        - Key: DataClassification
+          Value: !Ref DataClassification
+        - Key: Hipaa
+          Value: !Ref Hipaa
+
+  EcsSecurityGroupIngressFromSelf:
+    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupIngress
+    Properties:
+      Description: Ingress from other containers in the same security group
+      GroupId: !Ref FargateContainerSecurityGroup
+      IpProtocol: "-1"
+      SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref FargateContainerSecurityGroup
+
+  EcsSecurityGroupIngressFromPublicALB:
+    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupIngress
+    Properties:
+      Description: Ingress from the public ALB
+      GroupId: !Ref FargateContainerSecurityGroup
+      IpProtocol: "-1"
+      SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref PublicLoadBalancerSG
+
+  PublicLoadBalancerIngressFromSelf:
+    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupIngress
+    Properties:
+      Description: Allows communcation between security group members
+      GroupId: !Ref PublicLoadBalancerSG
+      IpProtocol: "-1"
+      SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref PublicLoadBalancerSG
+
+  PublicLoadBalancer:
+    # The load balancer is placed into the public subnets, so that traffic
+    # from the internet can reach the load balancer directly via the internet
+    # gateway
+    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::LoadBalancer
+    Properties:
+      Scheme: internet-facing
+      LoadBalancerAttributes:
+        - Key: idle_timeout.timeout_seconds
+          Value: "30"
+      Subnets: !Ref PublicSubnets
+      SecurityGroups:
+        - !Ref PublicLoadBalancerSG
+        - Fn::If:
+            - IsPublic
+            - !GetAtt PublicSecurityGroup.GroupId
+            - !GetAtt LillyNetworkSecurityGroup.GroupId
+      Tags:
+        - Key: ProjectName
+          Value: !Ref ServiceName
+        - Key: Environment
+          Value: !Ref DeployEnvironment
+        - Key: CostCenter
+          Value: !Ref CostCenter
+        - Key: CostCenterApprover
+          Value: !Ref CostCenterApprover
+        - Key: SystemOwner
+          Value: !Ref SystemOwner
+        - Key: SystemCustodian
+          Value: !Ref SystemCustodian
+        - Key: PrimaryItContact
+          Value: !Ref PrimaryItContact
+        - Key: Level1BusinessArea
+          Value: !Ref Level1BusinessArea
+        - Key: DataClassification
+          Value: !Ref DataClassification
+        - Key: Hipaa
+          Value: !Ref Hipaa
+
+  TargetGroup:
+    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::TargetGroup
+    Properties:
+      HealthCheckIntervalSeconds: !Ref HealthCheckIntervalSeconds
+      HealthCheckPath: !Ref HealthCheckPath
+      HealthCheckProtocol: HTTP
+      HealthCheckTimeoutSeconds: 5
+      HealthyThresholdCount: 2
+      Matcher:
+        HttpCode: 200,302,301
+      TargetType: ip
+      Port: !Ref ContainerPort
+      Protocol: HTTP
+      VpcId: !ImportValue DefaultVPC
+      Tags:
+        - Key: ProjectName
+          Value: !Ref ServiceName
+        - Key: Environment
+          Value: !Ref DeployEnvironment
+        - Key: CostCenter
+          Value: !Ref CostCenter
+        - Key: CostCenterApprover
+          Value: !Ref CostCenterApprover
+        - Key: SystemOwner
+          Value: !Ref SystemOwner
+        - Key: SystemCustodian
+          Value: !Ref SystemCustodian
+        - Key: PrimaryItContact
+          Value: !Ref PrimaryItContact
+        - Key: Level1BusinessArea
+          Value: !Ref Level1BusinessArea
+        - Key: DataClassification
+          Value: !Ref DataClassification
+        - Key: Hipaa
+          Value: !Ref Hipaa
+
+  PublicLoadBalancerHttpListener:
+    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::Listener
+    Properties:
+      DefaultActions:
+        - TargetGroupArn: !Ref TargetGroup
+          Type: forward
+      LoadBalancerArn: !Ref PublicLoadBalancer
+      Port: 80
+      Protocol: HTTP
+
+  PublicLoadBalancerHttpsListener:
+    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::Listener
+    Properties:
+      Certificates:
+        - CertificateArn: !Ref HttpsCertificate
+      DefaultActions:
+        - TargetGroupArn: !Ref TargetGroup
+          Type: forward
+      LoadBalancerArn: !Ref PublicLoadBalancer
+      Port: 443
+      Protocol: HTTPS
+
+  LoadBalancerHttpRule:
+    # Creates a rule on the load balancer for routing HTTP traffic to the target group
+    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::ListenerRule
+    Properties:
+      Actions:
+        - TargetGroupArn: !Ref TargetGroup
+          Type: forward
+      Conditions:
+        - Field: path-pattern
+          Values:
+            - "*"
+      ListenerArn: !Ref PublicLoadBalancerHttpListener
+      Priority: 1
+
+  LoadBalancerHttpsRule:
+    # Creates a rule on the load balancer for routing HTTPS traffic to the target group
+    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::ListenerRule
+    Properties:
+      Actions:
+        - TargetGroupArn: !Ref TargetGroup
+          Type: forward
+      Conditions:
+        - Field: path-pattern
+          Values:
+            - "*"
+      ListenerArn: !Ref PublicLoadBalancerHttpsListener
+      Priority: 1
+
+  PublicLoadBalancerRecordSet:
+    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
+    Properties:
+      AliasTarget:
+        DNSName: !GetAtt PublicLoadBalancer.DNSName
+        HostedZoneId: !GetAtt PublicLoadBalancer.CanonicalHostedZoneID
+      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZoneId
+      Name: !Ref DomainName
+      Type: A
+
+  HttpsCertificate:
+    Type: AWS::CertificateManager::Certificate
+    Properties:
+      DomainName: !Ref DomainName
+      DomainValidationOptions:
+        - DomainName: !Ref DomainName
+          HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZoneId
+      ValidationMethod: DNS
+      Tags:
+        - Key: ProjectName
+          Value: !Ref ServiceName
+        - Key: Environment
+          Value: !Ref DeployEnvironment
+        - Key: CostCenter
+          Value: !Ref CostCenter
+        - Key: CostCenterApprover
+          Value: !Ref CostCenterApprover
+        - Key: SystemOwner
+          Value: !Ref SystemOwner
+        - Key: SystemCustodian
+          Value: !Ref SystemCustodian
+        - Key: PrimaryItContact
+          Value: !Ref PrimaryItContact
+        - Key: Level1BusinessArea
+          Value: !Ref Level1BusinessArea
+        - Key: DataClassification
+          Value: !Ref DataClassification
+        - Key: Hipaa
+          Value: !Ref Hipaa
+
+  AutoScalingRole:
+    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
+    Properties:
+      PermissionsBoundary: !Sub arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:policy/LZ-IAM-Boundary
+      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
+        Version: "2012-10-17"
+        Statement:
+          - Effect: Allow
+            Principal:
+              Service:
+                - application-autoscaling.amazonaws.com
+            Action:
+              - sts:AssumeRole
+      Policies:
+        - PolicyName: AutoScalingRolePolicy
+          PolicyDocument:
+            Version: "2012-10-17"
+            Statement:
+              - Effect: Allow
+                Action:
+                  - application-autoscaling:*
+                  - ecs:RunTask
+                  - ecs:UpdateService
+                  - ecs:DescribeServices
+                  - cloudwatch:PutMetricAlarm
+                  - cloudwatch:DescribeAlarms
+                  - cloudwatch:GetMetricStatistics
+                  - cloudwatch:SetAlarmState
+                  - cloudwatch:DeleteAlarms
+                Resource: "*"
+      Tags:
+        - Key: ProjectName
+          Value: !Ref ServiceName
+        - Key: Environment
+          Value: !Ref DeployEnvironment
+        - Key: CostCenter
+          Value: !Ref CostCenter
+        - Key: CostCenterApprover
+          Value: !Ref CostCenterApprover
+        - Key: SystemOwner
+          Value: !Ref SystemOwner
+        - Key: SystemCustodian
+          Value: !Ref SystemCustodian
+        - Key: PrimaryItContact
+          Value: !Ref PrimaryItContact
+        - Key: Level1BusinessArea
+          Value: !Ref Level1BusinessArea
+        - Key: DataClassification
+          Value: !Ref DataClassification
+        - Key: Hipaa
+          Value: !Ref Hipaa
+
+  AutoScalingTarget:
+    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
+    DependsOn: Service
+    Properties:
+      MaxCapacity: !Ref MaxTaskCount
+      MinCapacity: 0
+      ResourceId:
+        !Join
+        - /
+        - - service
+          - !Ref Cluster
+          - !Ref ServiceName
+      RoleARN: !GetAtt AutoScalingRole.Arn
+      ScalableDimension: ecs:service:DesiredCount
+      ServiceNamespace: ecs
+
+  CPUAutoScalingPolicy:
+    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
+    Properties:
+      PolicyName: CPUAutoScalingPolicy
+      PolicyType: TargetTrackingScaling
+      ScalingTargetId: !Ref AutoScalingTarget
+      TargetTrackingScalingPolicyConfiguration:
+        TargetValue: !Ref CPUScalingPercentage
+        ScaleInCooldown: 300
+        ScaleOutCooldown: 60
+        PredefinedMetricSpecification:
+          PredefinedMetricType: ECSServiceAverageCPUUtilization
+
+  RequestsAutoScalingPolicy:
+    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
+    Properties:
+      PolicyName: RequestsAutoScalingPolicy
+      PolicyType: StepScaling
+      ScalingTargetId: !Ref AutoScalingTarget
+      StepScalingPolicyConfiguration:
+        AdjustmentType: ChangeInCapacity
+        Cooldown: 60
+        MetricAggregationType: Average
+        StepAdjustments:
+          - MetricIntervalLowerBound: 0
+            ScalingAdjustment: 1
+          - MetricIntervalUpperBound: 0
+            ScalingAdjustment: -1
+
+  RequestsAlarm:
+    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
+    Properties:
+      MetricName: !Sub ${ServiceName}RequestCountPerTarget
+      Namespace: AWS/ApplicationELB
+      Statistic: Sum
+      Period: 60
+      EvaluationPeriods: 1
+      Threshold: !Ref RequestsPerMinuteScaling
+      AlarmActions:
+        - !Ref RequestsAutoScalingPolicy
+      OKActions:
+        - !Ref RequestsAutoScalingPolicy
+      Dimensions:
+        - Name: TargetGroup
+          Value: !GetAtt TargetGroup.TargetGroupFullName
+      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
+
+  ReleaseTaskDefinition:
+    Type: AWS::ECS::TaskDefinition
+    Properties:
+      Family: !Ref ServiceName
+      Cpu: !Ref ContainerCpu
+      Memory: !Ref ContainerMemory
+      NetworkMode: awsvpc
+      RequiresCompatibilities:
+        - FARGATE

+AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
+Description: This Cloudformation creates sagemaker pipeline
+
+Parameters:
+  pProjectId:
+    Description: Project Id
+    Type: String
+    Default: 9971d8d9e7c09db7d24b444c6e87f9
+  pSMPipelineName:
+    Description: Pipeline Name
+    Type: String
+    Default: MyTestSageMakerPipeline
+  pCodeConfigBucket:
+    Description: Event bucket name
+    Type: String
+    Default: lly-edp-codeconfig-us-east-2-dev
+  pEventRulePrefix:
+    Description: Event rule prefix after the project folder in exploratory bucket
+    Type: String
+
+Resources:
+
+  # Below is a sample pipeline which creates a 3 step pipeline following AWB Flow
+  # Comment/Update the below resource if it isnt required
+  AWBSageMakerPipeline:
+    Type: 'AWS::SageMaker::Pipeline'
+    Properties:
+      PipelineName: !Sub '${pProjectId}-${pSMPipelineName}'
+      PipelineDisplayName: 'SMPipelineTest'
+      PipelineDescription: 'Pipeline to fetch data from S3, preprocess, train model, and register model'
+      RoleArn: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/aads_awb_aws_sm_${pProjectId}'
+      PipelineDefinition:
+        PipelineDefinitionS3Location:
+          Bucket: !Ref pCodeConfigBucket
+          Key: !Sub 'awb/sagemaker-pipeline/${pProjectId}/definitions/sm-pipeline-definition.json'
+      Tags:
+        - Key: "ProjectId"
+          Value: !Ref pProjectId
+
+  # Below is a eventbridge rule to trigger the sagemaker pipeline
+  # Comment the below resource if it isnt required
+  ConfigEventRule:
+    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
+    Properties:
+        Description: Event bridge rule for triggering sagemaker pipeline
+        EventBusName: default
+        EventPattern:
+          detail-type:
+            - AWS API Call via CloudTrail
+          source:
+            - aws.s3
+          detail:
+            eventSource:
+              - s3.amazonaws.com
+            requestParameters:
+              bucketName:
+                - !Ref pCodeConfigBucket
+              key:
+                - prefix: !Sub "awb/sagemaker-pipeline/${pProjectId}/${pEventRulePrefix}"
+            eventName:
+              - PutObject
+        Name: !Sub "aads_edb_awb_${pProjectId}_sm_pipeline"
+        State: ENABLED
+        Targets:
+        - Id: SMPipelineTrigger
+          Arn:
+            Fn::Sub: >-
+              arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:pipeline/${pProjectId}-${pSMPipelineName}
+          RoleArn:
+            Fn::Sub: >-
+              arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/aads_awb_aws_sm_${pProjectId}
+
+  # Below is a sample pipeline which creates a training job
+  # Comment the below resource if it isnt required
+  AWBSageMakerPipeline1:
+    Type: 'AWS::SageMaker::Pipeline'
+    Properties:
+      PipelineName: !Sub '${pProjectId}-${pSMPipelineName}-tj'
+      PipelineDisplayName: 'SMPipelineTest1'
+      PipelineDescription: 'Test pipeline to create training job'
+      RoleArn: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/aads_awb_aws_sm_${pProjectId}'
+      PipelineDefinition:
+        PipelineDefinitionS3Location:
+          Bucket: !Ref pCodeConfigBucket
+          Key: !Sub 'awb/sagemaker-pipeline/${pProjectId}/definitions/sm-pipeline-definition-tj.json'
+      Tags:
+        - Key: "ProjectId"
+          Value: !Ref pProjectId
label: CT1

+AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
+Description: This Cloudformation creates sagemaker pipeline
+
+Parameters:
+  pProjectId:
+    Description: Project Id
+    Type: String
+    Default: 9971d8d9e7c09db7d24b444c6e87f9
+  pSMPipelineName:
+    Description: Pipeline Name
+    Type: String
+    Default: MyTestSageMakerPipeline
+  pCodeConfigBucket:
+    Description: Event bucket name
+    Type: String
+    Default: lly-edp-codeconfig-us-east-2-dev
+  pEventRulePrefix:
+    Description: Event rule prefix after the project folder in exploratory bucket
+    Type: String
+
+Resources:
+  CustomSageMakerPipeline:
+    Type: 'AWS::SageMaker::Pipeline'
+    Properties:
+      PipelineName: !Sub '${pProjectId}-${pSMPipelineName}'
+      PipelineDisplayName: 'MyTestSageMakerPipeline'
+      PipelineDescription: 'Pipeline to fetch data from S3, preprocess, train model, and register model'
+      RoleArn: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/aads_awb_aws_sm_${pProjectId}'
+      PipelineDefinition:
+        PipelineDefinitionS3Location:
+          Bucket: 'lly-edp-codeconfig-us-east-2-dev'
+          Key: 'awb/sagemaker-pipeline/test-pipeline-definition.json'
+      Tags:
+        - Key: "ProjectId"
+          Value: "9971d8d9e7c09db7d24b444c6e87f9"
+
+  ConfigEventRule:
+    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
+    Properties:
+        Description: Event bridge rule for triggering sagemaker pipeline
+        EventBusName: default
+        EventPattern:
+          detail-type:
+            - AWS API Call via CloudTrail
+          source:

@@ -0,0 +1,88 @@
+AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
+Description: This Cloudformation creates sagemaker pipeline
+
+Parameters:
+  pProjectId:
+    Description: Project Id
+    Type: String
+    Default: 9971d8d9e7c09db7d24b444c6e87f9
+  pSMPipelineName:
+    Description: Pipeline Name
+    Type: String
+    Default: MyTestSageMakerPipeline
+  pCodeConfigBucket:
+    Description: Event bucket name
+    Type: String
+    Default: lly-edp-codeconfig-us-east-2-dev
+  pEventRulePrefix:
+    Description: Event rule prefix after the project folder in exploratory bucket
+    Type: String
+
+Resources:
+
+  # Below is a sample pipeline which creates a 3 step pipeline following AWB Flow
+  # Comment/Update the below resource if it isnt required
+  AWBSageMakerPipeline:
+    Type: 'AWS::SageMaker::Pipeline'
+    Properties:
+      PipelineName: !Sub '${pProjectId}-${pSMPipelineName}'
+      PipelineDisplayName: 'SMPipelineTest'
+      PipelineDescription: 'Pipeline to fetch data from S3, preprocess, train model, and register model'
+      RoleArn: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/aads_awb_aws_sm_${pProjectId}'
+      PipelineDefinition:
+        PipelineDefinitionS3Location:
+          Bucket: !Ref pCodeConfigBucket
+          Key: !Sub 'awb/sagemaker-pipeline/${pProjectId}/definitions/sm-pipeline-definition.json'
+      Tags:
+        - Key: "ProjectId"
+          Value: !Ref pProjectId
+
+  # Below is a eventbridge rule to trigger the sagemaker pipeline
+  # Comment the below resource if it isnt required
+  ConfigEventRule:
+    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
+    Properties:
+        Description: Event bridge rule for triggering sagemaker pipeline
+        EventBusName: default
+        EventPattern:
+          detail-type:
+            - AWS API Call via CloudTrail
+          source:
+            - aws.s3
+          detail:
+            eventSource:
+              - s3.amazonaws.com
+            requestParameters:
+              bucketName:
+                - !Ref pCodeConfigBucket
+              key:
+                - prefix: !Sub "awb/sagemaker-pipeline/${pProjectId}/${pEventRulePrefix}"
+            eventName:
+              - PutObject
+        Name: !Sub "aads_edb_awb_${pProjectId}_sm_pipeline"
+        State: ENABLED
+        Targets:
+        - Id: SMPipelineTrigger
+          Arn:
+            Fn::Sub: >-
+              arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:pipeline/${pProjectId}-${pSMPipelineName}
+          RoleArn:
+            Fn::Sub: >-
+              arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/aads_awb_aws_sm_${pProjectId}
+
+  # Below is a sample pipeline which creates a training job
+  # Comment the below resource if it isnt required
+  AWBSageMakerPipeline1:
+    Type: 'AWS::SageMaker::Pipeline'
+    Properties:
+      PipelineName: !Sub '${pProjectId}-${pSMPipelineName}-tj'
+      PipelineDisplayName: 'SMPipelineTest1'
+      PipelineDescription: 'Test pipeline to create training job'
+      RoleArn: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/aads_awb_aws_sm_${pProjectId}'
+      PipelineDefinition:
+        PipelineDefinitionS3Location:
+          Bucket: !Ref pCodeConfigBucket
+          Key: !Sub 'awb/sagemaker-pipeline/${pProjectId}/definitions/sm-pipeline-definition-tj.json'
+      Tags:
+        - Key: "ProjectId"
+          Value: !Ref pProjectId
label: CT1
label_reason: Mirrors PR #19: introduces a new template.yml with IAM RoleArn and an S3-triggered EventBridge rule plus numerous new S3 upload steps, a data-access change.

+AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
+Resources:
+  S3Bucket:
+    Type: 'AWS::S3::Bucket'
+    Properties:

+    Type: 'AWS::S3::BucketPolicy'
+    Properties:
+      Bucket: !Ref S3Bucket
+      PolicyDocument:

+          - Sid: AllowCloudFrontRead

+            Principal:

+            Action: s3:GetObject
+            Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:::${S3Bucket}/*'
+  CloudFrontDistribution:
+    Type: 'AWS::CloudFront::Distribution'
+    Properties:
+      DistributionConfig:
+        Origins:
+          - DomainName: !GetAtt S3Bucket.DomainName
+            Id: S3Origin
+            S3OriginConfig:
+              OriginAccessIdentity: !Sub 'origin-access-identity/cloudfront/${AWS::AccountId}'
+        Enabled: true
+        DefaultRootObject: index.html
+        DefaultCacheBehavior:
+          TargetOriginId: S3Origin
+          ViewerProtocolPolicy: redirect-to-https
+          ForwardedValues:
+            QueryString: false
\ No newline at end of file

+AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
+Parameters:

+      - PriceClass_200

+    DependsOn: CloudFrontAccessIdentity

+        ReadWriteAccess:
+          "*":
+            - !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/ChangeControlGithubDeployRole'
+        PermissionScopes:
+          Account: false
+      CloudFrontAccess:
+        CanonicalUser: !GetAtt "CloudFrontAccessIdentity.S3CanonicalUserId"
+        Prefix: "PUBLIC"
+
+
+  WebsiteCloudFrontDefault:
+    Type: AWS::CloudFront::Distribution
+    Properties:
+      DistributionConfig:
+        WebACLId: !GetAtt LillyIPsWebACL.Arn
+        ViewerCertificate:
+          CloudFrontDefaultCertificate: true
+        DefaultCacheBehavior:
+          Compress: true
+          AllowedMethods:
+            - GET
+            - HEAD
+            - OPTIONS
+          CachedMethods:
+            - GET
+            - HEAD
+          ForwardedValues:
+            QueryString: false
+            Headers: []
+          ViewerProtocolPolicy: redirect-to-https
+          TargetOriginId: S3WebsiteOrigin
+          DefaultTTL: 86400
+          MaxTTL: 31536000
+          MinTTL: 0
+        DefaultRootObject: index.html
+        Enabled: true
+        Origins:
+          - DomainName: !Sub
+              - "${BucketName}.s3.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com"
+              - { BucketName: !Ref WebS3Bucket }
+            Id: S3WebsiteOrigin
+            OriginPath: !Join
+              - ""
+              - - /
+                - !Ref CloudFrontAccessPrefix
+            S3OriginConfig:
+              OriginAccessIdentity: !Join
+                - ""
+                - - origin-access-identity/cloudfront/
+                  - !Ref CloudFrontAccessIdentity
+        PriceClass: !Ref CloudFrontPriceClass
+        CustomErrorResponses:
+          - ErrorCode: 403
+            ResponseCode: 200
+            ResponsePagePath: "/index.html"
+            ErrorCachingMinTTL: 300
+          - ErrorCode: 404
+            ResponseCode: 200
+            ResponsePagePath: "/index.html"
+            ErrorCachingMinTTL: 300
+
+  CloudFrontAccessIdentity:
+    Type: AWS::CloudFront::CloudFrontOriginAccessIdentity
+    Properties:
+      CloudFrontOriginAccessIdentityConfig:
+        Comment: !Sub "${AppName} CloudFront Origin Identity"

+            ResponseCode: 401
+      Scope: "CLOUDFRONT"

+AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
+Transform: "AWS::Serverless-2016-10-31"
+
+Description: >
+    mdids ihub CRM api integration
+Parameters:
+
+    DeployEnvironment:
+        Type: String
+        AllowedValues:
+            - dev
+            - qa
+            - prod
+    FunctionCurrentVersionAlias:
+        Type: String
+        Default: live
+    AppName:
+        Type: String
+    CostCenter:
+        Type: String
+    CostCenterApprover:
+        Type: String
+    SystemOwner:
+        Type: String
+    SystemCustodian:
+        Type: String
+    PrimaryItContact:
+        Type: String
+    Level1BusinessArea:
+        Type: String
+    DataClassification:
+        Type: String
+        AllowedValues:
+            - "Green"
+            - "Yellow"
+            - "Orange"
+            - "Red"
+            - "TBD"
+    Hipaa:
+        Type: String
+        AllowedValues:
+            - "Yes"
+            - "No"
+            - "TBD"   
+
+    DwsPlatformRole:
+        Type: String
+        Description: "principal name"
+    DwsAutomatedKMSAliasPrefix:
+        Type: String
+        Description: "dwskmsalias"
+    SecretIdKMSKey:
+        Type: String
+        
+Resources:
+
+    IAMRoleForCodeDeploy:
+        Type: AWS::IAM::Role
+        Properties:
+            ManagedPolicyArns:
+                - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSCodeDeployRoleForLambda"
+            PermissionsBoundary: !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:policy/LZ-IAM-Boundary"
+            AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
+                Version: "2012-10-17"
+                Statement:
+                    - 
+                        Effect: Allow
+                        Action: sts:AssumeRole
+                        Principal:
+                            Service:
+                                - codedeploy.amazonaws.com
+    
+
+    EdbCrmDwsRole:
+        Type: AWS::IAM::Role
+        Properties:
+          AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
+            Version: 2012-10-17
+            Statement:
+              - Effect: Allow
+                Principal:
+                  AWS:
+                  - Ref: DwsPlatformRole
+                  Service:
+                  - s3.amazonaws.com
+                  - eks.amazonaws.com
+                Action:
+                - sts:AssumeRole
+          Description: Cross account IAM role for DWS Role
+          MaxSessionDuration: 43200
+          PermissionsBoundary:
+            Fn::Sub: arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:policy/LZ-IAM-Boundary
+          RoleName: edb_mdids_ihub_crm_dws_cross_account_role
+
+    EdbCrmsDwsSecretAccessPolicy:
+        Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
+        Properties:
+          ManagedPolicyName: edb_mdids_ihub_crm_dws_secret_policy
+          Description: Secret access policy for DWS Apis using RDS
+          PolicyDocument:
+            Version: 2012-10-17
+            Statement:
+            - Effect: Allow
+              Action:
+              - secretsmanager:GetResourcePolicy
+              - secretsmanager:GetSecretValue
+              - secretsmanager:DescribeSecret
+              - secretsmanager:ListSecretVersionIds
+              Resource:
+              - Fn::Sub: arn:aws:secretsmanager:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:secret:awsedb-md-clinical-results-cluster-??????
+            - Effect: Allow
+              Action:
+              - secretsmanager:ListSecrets
+              Resource: '*'
+          Roles:
+          - Ref: EdbCrmDwsRole
+
+    EdbCrmKMSAccessPolicy:
+      Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
+      Properties:
+        ManagedPolicyName: edb_mdids_ihub_crm_dws_kms_policy
+        Description: KMS access Policy For DWS Apis using encrypted resources
+        PolicyDocument:
+          Version: 2012-10-17
+          Statement:
+          - Effect: Allow
+            Action:
+            - kms:Decrypt
+            - kms:GenerateDataKey
+            Resource:
+            - Ref: SecretIdKMSKey 
+            - Fn::Sub: arn:aws:kms:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:alias/${DwsAutomatedKMSAliasPrefix}*
+        Roles:
+        - Ref: EdbCrmDwsRole
+                       
+           
+Outputs:
+    AppName:
+        Description: "deployed application"
+        Value: !Ref AppName

+      uses: ScottBrenner/cfn-lint-action@v2.4.2
+    
+    - name: Print the Cloud Formation Linter Version & run Linter.
+      run: |
+        cfn-lint --version
+        cfn-lint -t ./template.yml -i W3002
+        
+    - name: Set env BRANCH
+      run: echo "BRANCH=$(echo $GITHUB_REF | cut -d'/' -f 3)" >> $GITHUB_ENV
+    
+    - name: Set permissions for tags.dev.json
+      run: |
+        chmod +r ./tags.dev.json
+        chmod +r ./tags.qa.json
+        chmod +r ./tags.prod.json
+
+    - name: Set env DEPLOYMENT_ENV and DEPLOYMENT_ROLE_ARN and S3_BUCKET
+      env: 
+        DEV_DEPLOYMENT_ROLE: ${{ vars.DEPLOYMENT_ROLE_DEV }}
+        QA_DEPLOYMENT_ROLE: ${{ vars.DEPLOYMENT_ROLE_QA }}
+        PROD_DEPLOYMENT_ROLE: ${{ vars.DEPLOYMENT_ROLE_PROD }}
+        DEV_S3_BUCKET: ${{ vars.S3_BUCKET_DEV }}
+        QA_S3_BUCKET: ${{ vars.S3_BUCKET_QA }}
+        PROD_S3_BUCKET: ${{ vars.S3_BUCKET_PROD }}
+
+      run: |
+         if [[ $BRANCH == 'master' || $BRANCH == 'main' ]]; then 
+          echo "DEPLOYMENT_ENV=prod" >> "$GITHUB_ENV" 
+          echo "DEPLOYMENT_ROLE_ARN=$PROD_DEPLOYMENT_ROLE" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
+          echo "S3_BUCKET=$PROD_S3_BUCKET" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
+          echo "DEPLOYMENT_TAGS<<EOF" >> $GITHUB_ENV
+          echo $(<./tags.prod.json) >> $GITHUB_ENV
+          echo "EOF" >> $GITHUB_ENV
+         elif [[ $BRANCH == 'qa' ]]; then
+          echo "DEPLOYMENT_ENV=qa" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
+          echo "DEPLOYMENT_ROLE_ARN=$QA_DEPLOYMENT_ROLE" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
+          echo "S3_BUCKET=$QA_S3_BUCKET" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
+          echo "DEPLOYMENT_TAGS<<EOF" >> $GITHUB_ENV
+          echo $(<./tags.qa.json) >> $GITHUB_ENV
+          echo "EOF" >> $GITHUB_ENV
+         else 
+          echo "DEPLOYMENT_ENV=dev" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
+          echo "DEPLOYMENT_ROLE_ARN=$DEV_DEPLOYMENT_ROLE" >> "$GITHUB_ENV" 
+          echo "S3_BUCKET=$DEV_S3_BUCKET" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
+          echo "DEPLOYMENT_TAGS<<EOF" >> $GITHUB_ENV
+          echo $(<./tags.dev.json) >> $GITHUB_ENV
+          echo "EOF" >> $GITHUB_ENV
+         fi
+    - name: Configure credentials from AWS account using OIDC integration
+      uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@v4
+      with:
+        role-to-assume: ${{env.DEPLOYMENT_ROLE_ARN}}
+        aws-region: ${{ vars.AWS_REGION }}
+
+    - name: Setup Python
+      uses: actions/setup-python@v5
+      with:
+        python-version: "3.9"
+
+    - name: Pre-Building the Project
+      run: |
+        echo "done copying the functions file to each lambda function directory"
+
+    - name: Setup AWS SAM
+      uses: aws-actions/setup-sam@v2
+      
+    - name: AWS SAM Build
+      run: sam build --use-container --template-file template.yml
+      
+    - name: sam package
+      run: sam package --template-file .aws-sam/build/template.yaml --s3-bucket ${{ env.S3_BUCKET }} --output-template-file template.yml --kms-key-id alias/aws/s3
+
+    - name: Upload CloudFormation Template to S3
+      run: |
+        aws s3 cp ./template.yml s3://${{ env.S3_BUCKET }}/${{ github.event.repository.name }}/template.yml    
+
+    - name: Deploy to AWS Cloudformation
+      uses: aws-actions/aws-cloudformation-github-deploy@v1
+      with: 
+        name: pipeline-${{ github.event.repository.name }}-deployment
+        template: https://s3.amazonaws.com/${{ env.S3_BUCKET }}/${{ github.event.repository.name }}/template.yml
+        parameter-overrides: file://${{ github.workspace }}/params.${{ env.DEPLOYMENT_ENV }}.json
+        changeset: --change-set-name
+        capabilities: CAPABILITY_IAM,CAPABILITY_AUTO_EXPAND, CAPABILITY_NAMED_IAM
+        no-fail-on-empty-changeset: "1"
+        tags: ${{ env.DEPLOYMENT_TAGS }}
+

new file mode 100644

--- /dev/null
+++ b/template.yml
@@ -0,0 +1,152 @@
+AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
+Transform: "AWS::Serverless-2016-10-31"
+
+Description: >
+    mdids ihub CRM api integration
+Parameters:
+
+    DeployEnvironment:
+        Type: String
+        AllowedValues:
+            - dev
+            - qa
+            - prod
+    FunctionCurrentVersionAlias:
+        Type: String
+        Default: live
+    AppName:
+        Type: String
+    CostCenter:
+        Type: String
+    CostCenterApprover:
+        Type: String
+    SystemOwner:
+        Type: String
+    SystemCustodian:
+        Type: String
+    PrimaryItContact:
+        Type: String
+    Level1BusinessArea:
+        Type: String
+    DataClassification:
+        Type: String
+        AllowedValues:
+            - "Green"
+            - "Yellow"
+            - "Orange"
+            - "Red"
+            - "TBD"
+    Hipaa:
+        Type: String
+        AllowedValues:
+            - "Yes"
+            - "No"
+            - "TBD"   
+
+    DwsPlatformRole:
+        Type: String
+        Description: "principal name"
+    DwsAutomatedKMSAliasPrefix:
+        Type: String
+        Description: "dwskmsalias"
+    DwsAutomatedSecretPrefix:
+        Type: String
+        Description: "dwsautomatedsecret" 
+    SecretIdKMSKey:
+        Type: String
+    pCTMSApiDbSecretName:
+        Type: String
+    pAcccessRoleName:
+        Type: String
+    pCrmTargetDbSecret:
+        Type: String
+    pAcccessPolicyName:
+        Type: String
+        
+Resources:
+
+    IAMRoleForCodeDeploy:
+        Type: AWS::IAM::Role
+        Properties:
+            ManagedPolicyArns:
+                - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSCodeDeployRoleForLambda"
+            PermissionsBoundary: !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:policy/LZ-IAM-Boundary"
+            AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
+                Version: "2012-10-17"
+                Statement:
+                    - 
+                        Effect: Allow
+                        Action: sts:AssumeRole
+                        Principal:
+                            Service:
+                                - codedeploy.amazonaws.com
+    
+
+    EdbCrmDwsRole:
+        Type: AWS::IAM::Role
+        Properties:
+          AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
+            Version: 2012-10-17
+            Statement:
+              - Effect: Allow
+                Principal:
+                  AWS:
+                  - Ref: DwsPlatformRole
+                  Service:
+                  - s3.amazonaws.com
+                  - eks.amazonaws.com
+                Action:
+                - sts:AssumeRole
+          Description: Cross account IAM role for DWS Role
+          MaxSessionDuration: 43200
+          PermissionsBoundary:
+            Fn::Sub: arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:policy/LZ-IAM-Boundary
+          RoleName: !Ref pAcccessRoleName
+
+    EdbCrmsDwsSecretAccessPolicy:
+        Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
+        Properties:
+          ManagedPolicyName: !Ref pAcccessPolicyName
+          Description: Secret access policy for DWS Apis using RDS
+          PolicyDocument:
+            Version: 2012-10-17
+            Statement:
+            - Effect: Allow
+              Action:
+              - secretsmanager:GetResourcePolicy
+              - secretsmanager:GetSecretValue
+              - secretsmanager:DescribeSecret
+              - secretsmanager:ListSecretVersionIds
+              Resource:
+              - Fn::Sub: arn:aws:secretsmanager:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:secret:${DwsAutomatedSecretPrefix}*
+              - Fn::Sub: arn:aws:secretsmanager:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:secret:${pCrmTargetDbSecret}-??????
+            - Effect: Allow
+              Action:
+              - secretsmanager:ListSecrets
+              Resource: '*'
+          Roles:
+          - Ref: EdbCrmDwsRole
+
+    EdbCrmKMSAccessPolicy:
+      Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
+      Properties:
+        ManagedPolicyName: edb_mdids_ihub_crm_dws_kms_access_policy
+        Description: KMS access Policy For DWS Apis using encrypted resources
+        PolicyDocument:
+          Version: 2012-10-17
+          Statement:
+          - Effect: Allow
+            Action:
+            - kms:Decrypt
+            - kms:GenerateDataKey
+            Resource:
+            - Ref: SecretIdKMSKey 
+            - Fn::Sub: arn:aws:kms:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:alias/${DwsAutomatedKMSAliasPrefix}*
+        Roles:
+        - Ref: EdbCrmDwsRole
+                       
+           
+Outputs:
+    AppName:
+        Description: "deployed application"
+        Value: !Ref AppName
\ No newline at end of file

new file mode 100644
index 0000000..24809fc
--- /dev/null
+++ b/.github/workflows/deploy.yml
@@ -0,0 +1,112 @@
+name: Deploy cloudformation
+
+on: 
+  push:     
+    branches:
+      - dev
+      - develop
+      - qa
+      - main
+      - master
+      
+permissions: read-all
+jobs:
+  cloudformation-deploy:
+    name: Deploy Cloudformation
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    permissions:
+      id-token: write
+      contents: read
+
+    steps:
+    - name: Checkout
+      uses: actions/checkout@v4
+    
+    - name: cfn-lint-action
+      uses: ScottBrenner/cfn-lint-action@v2.4.2
+    
+    - name: Print the Cloud Formation Linter Version & run Linter.
+      run: |
+        cfn-lint --version
+        cfn-lint -t ./template.yml -i W3002
+        
+    - name: Set env BRANCH
+      run: echo "BRANCH=$(echo $GITHUB_REF | cut -d'/' -f 3)" >> $GITHUB_ENV
+    
+    - name: Set permissions for tags.dev.json
+      run: |
+        chmod +r ./tags.dev.json
+        chmod +r ./tags.qa.json
+        chmod +r ./tags.prod.json
+
+    - name: Set env DEPLOYMENT_ENV and DEPLOYMENT_ROLE_ARN and S3_BUCKET
+      env: 
+        DEV_DEPLOYMENT_ROLE: ${{ vars.DEPLOYMENT_ROLE_DEV }}
+        QA_DEPLOYMENT_ROLE: ${{ vars.DEPLOYMENT_ROLE_QA }}
+        PROD_DEPLOYMENT_ROLE: ${{ vars.DEPLOYMENT_ROLE_PROD }}
+        DEV_S3_BUCKET: ${{ vars.S3_BUCKET_DEV }}
+        QA_S3_BUCKET: ${{ vars.S3_BUCKET_QA }}
+        PROD_S3_BUCKET: ${{ vars.S3_BUCKET_PROD }}
+
+      run: |
+         if [[ $BRANCH == 'master' || $BRANCH == 'main' ]]; then 
+          echo "DEPLOYMENT_ENV=prod" >> "$GITHUB_ENV" 
+          echo "DEPLOYMENT_ROLE_ARN=$PROD_DEPLOYMENT_ROLE" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
+          echo "S3_BUCKET=$PROD_S3_BUCKET" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
+          echo "DEPLOYMENT_TAGS<<EOF" >> $GITHUB_ENV
+          echo $(<./tags.prod.json) >> $GITHUB_ENV
+          echo "EOF" >> $GITHUB_ENV
+         elif [[ $BRANCH == 'qa' ]]; then
+          echo "DEPLOYMENT_ENV=qa" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
+          echo "DEPLOYMENT_ROLE_ARN=$QA_DEPLOYMENT_ROLE" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
+          echo "S3_BUCKET=$QA_S3_BUCKET" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
+          echo "DEPLOYMENT_TAGS<<EOF" >> $GITHUB_ENV
+          echo $(<./tags.qa.json) >> $GITHUB_ENV
+          echo "EOF" >> $GITHUB_ENV
+         else 
+          echo "DEPLOYMENT_ENV=dev" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
+          echo "DEPLOYMENT_ROLE_ARN=$DEV_DEPLOYMENT_ROLE" >> "$GITHUB_ENV" 
+          echo "S3_BUCKET=$DEV_S3_BUCKET" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
+          echo "DEPLOYMENT_TAGS<<EOF" >> $GITHUB_ENV
+          echo $(<./tags.dev.json) >> $GITHUB_ENV
+          echo "EOF" >> $GITHUB_ENV
+         fi
+    - name: Configure credentials from AWS account using OIDC integration
+      uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@v4
+      with:
+        role-to-assume: ${{env.DEPLOYMENT_ROLE_ARN}}
+        aws-region: ${{ vars.AWS_REGION }}
+
+    - name: Setup Python
+      uses: actions/setup-python@v5
+      with:
+        python-version: "3.9"
+
+    - name: Pre-Building the Project
+      run: |
+        echo "done copying the functions file to each lambda function directory"
+
+    - name: Setup AWS SAM
+      uses: aws-actions/setup-sam@v2
+      
+    - name: AWS SAM Build
+      run: sam build --use-container --template-file template.yml
+      
+    - name: sam package
+      run: sam package --template-file .aws-sam/build/template.yaml --s3-bucket ${{ env.S3_BUCKET }} --output-template-file template.yml --kms-key-id alias/aws/s3
+
+    - name: Upload CloudFormation Template to S3
+      run: |
+        aws s3 cp ./template.yml s3://${{ env.S3_BUCKET }}/${{ github.event.repository.name }}/template.yml    
+
+    - name: Deploy to AWS Cloudformation
+      uses: aws-actions/aws-cloudformation-github-deploy@v1
+      with: 
+        name: pipeline-${{ github.event.repository.name }}-deployment
+        template: https://s3.amazonaws.com/${{ env.S3_BUCKET }}/${{ github.event.repository.name }}/template.yml
+        parameter-overrides: file://${{ github.workspace }}/params.${{ env.DEPLOYMENT_ENV }}.json
+        changeset: --change-set-name
+        capabilities: CAPABILITY_IAM,CAPABILITY_AUTO_EXPAND, CAPABILITY_NAMED_IAM
+        no-fail-on-empty-changeset: "1"
+        tags: ${{ env.DEPLOYMENT_TAGS }}
+   
\ No newline at end of file

@@ -0,0 +1,150 @@
+AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
+Transform: "AWS::Serverless-2016-10-31"
+
+Description: >
+    mdids ihub CRM api integration
+Parameters:
+
+    DeployEnvironment:
+        Type: String
+        AllowedValues:
+            - dev
+            - qa
+            - prod
+    FunctionCurrentVersionAlias:
+        Type: String
+        Default: live
+    AppName:
+        Type: String
+    CostCenter:
+        Type: String
+    CostCenterApprover:
+        Type: String
+    SystemOwner:
+        Type: String
+    SystemCustodian:
+        Type: String
+    PrimaryItContact:
+        Type: String
+    Level1BusinessArea:
+        Type: String
+    DataClassification:
+        Type: String
+        AllowedValues:
+            - "Green"
+            - "Yellow"
+            - "Orange"
+            - "Red"
+            - "TBD"
+    Hipaa:
+        Type: String
+        AllowedValues:
+            - "Yes"
+            - "No"
+            - "TBD"   
+
+    DwsPlatformRole:
+        Type: String
+        Description: "principal name"
+    DwsAutomatedKMSAliasPrefix:
+        Type: String
+        Description: "dwskmsalias"
+    DwsAutomatedSecretPrefix:
+        Type: String
+        Description: "dwsautomatedsecret" 
+    SecretIdKMSKey:
+        Type: String
+    pAcccessRoleName:
+        Type: String
+    pCrmTargetDbSecret:
+        Type: String
+    pAcccessPolicyName:
+        Type: String
+        
+Resources:
+
+    IAMRoleForCodeDeploy:
+        Type: AWS::IAM::Role
+        Properties:
+            ManagedPolicyArns:
+                - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSCodeDeployRoleForLambda"
+            PermissionsBoundary: !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:policy/LZ-IAM-Boundary"
+            AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
+                Version: "2012-10-17"
+                Statement:
+                    - 
+                        Effect: Allow
+                        Action: sts:AssumeRole
+                        Principal:
+                            Service:
+                                - codedeploy.amazonaws.com
+    
+
+    EdbCrmDwsRole:
+        Type: AWS::IAM::Role
+        Properties:
+          AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
+            Version: 2012-10-17
+            Statement:
+              - Effect: Allow
+                Principal:
+                  AWS:
+                  - Ref: DwsPlatformRole
+                  Service:
+                  - s3.amazonaws.com
+                  - eks.amazonaws.com
+                Action:
+                - sts:AssumeRole
+          Description: Cross account IAM role for DWS Role
+          MaxSessionDuration: 43200
+          PermissionsBoundary:
+            Fn::Sub: arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:policy/LZ-IAM-Boundary
+          RoleName: !Ref pAcccessRoleName
+
+    EdbCrmsDwsSecretAccessPolicy:
+        Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
+        Properties:
+          ManagedPolicyName: !Ref pAcccessPolicyName
+          Description: Secret access policy for DWS Apis using RDS
+          PolicyDocument:
+            Version: 2012-10-17
+            Statement:
+            - Effect: Allow
+              Action:
+              - secretsmanager:GetResourcePolicy
+              - secretsmanager:GetSecretValue
+              - secretsmanager:DescribeSecret
+              - secretsmanager:ListSecretVersionIds
+              Resource:
+              - Fn::Sub: arn:aws:secretsmanager:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:secret:${DwsAutomatedSecretPrefix}*
+              - Fn::Sub: arn:aws:secretsmanager:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:secret:${pCrmTargetDbSecret}-??????
+            - Effect: Allow
+              Action:
+              - secretsmanager:ListSecrets
+              Resource: '*'
+          Roles:
+          - Ref: EdbCrmDwsRole
+
+    EdbCrmKMSAccessPolicy:
+      Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
+      Properties:
+        ManagedPolicyName: edb_mdids_ihub_crm_dws_kms_policy
+        Description: KMS access Policy For DWS Apis using encrypted resources
+        PolicyDocument:
+          Version: 2012-10-17
+          Statement:
+          - Effect: Allow
+            Action:
+            - kms:Decrypt
+            - kms:GenerateDataKey
+            Resource:
+            - Ref: SecretIdKMSKey 
+            - Fn::Sub: arn:aws:kms:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:alias/${DwsAutomatedKMSAliasPrefix}*
+        Roles:
+        - Ref: EdbCrmDwsRole
+                       
+           
+Outputs:
+    AppName:
+        Description: "deployed application"
+        Value: !Ref AppName
\ No newline at end of file

+++ b/.github/workflows/deploy.yml
@@ -0,0 +1,121 @@
+name: Deploy cloudformation
+
+on: 
+  push:     
+    branches:
+      - dev
+      - develop
+      - qa
+      - main
+      - master
+      
+permissions: read-all
+jobs:
+  cloudformation-deploy:
+    name: Deploy Cloudformation
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    permissions:
+      id-token: write
+      contents: read
+
+    steps:
+    - name: Checkout
+      uses: actions/checkout@v2
+    
+    - name: cfn-lint-action
+      uses: ScottBrenner/cfn-lint-action@v2.2.9
+    
+    - name: Print the Cloud Formation Linter Version & run Linter.
+      run: |
+        cfn-lint --version
+        cfn-lint -t ./template.yml -i W3002
+        
+    - name: Set env BRANCH
+      run: echo "BRANCH=$(echo $GITHUB_REF | cut -d'/' -f 3)" >> $GITHUB_ENV
+    
+    - name: Set permissions for tags.dev.json
+      run: |
+        chmod +r ./tags.dev.json
+        chmod +r ./tags.qa.json
+        chmod +r ./tags.prod.json
+
+    - name: Set env DEPLOYMENT_ENV and DEPLOYMENT_ROLE_ARN and S3_BUCKET
+      env: 
+        DEV_DEPLOYMENT_ROLE: ${{ vars.DEPLOYMENT_ROLE_DEV }}
+        QA_DEPLOYMENT_ROLE: ${{ vars.DEPLOYMENT_ROLE_QA }}
+        PROD_DEPLOYMENT_ROLE: ${{ vars.DEPLOYMENT_ROLE_PROD }}
+        DEV_S3_BUCKET: ${{ vars.S3_BUCKET_DEV }}
+        QA_S3_BUCKET: ${{ vars.S3_BUCKET_QA }}
+        PROD_S3_BUCKET: ${{ vars.S3_BUCKET_PROD }}
+
+      run: |
+         if [[ $BRANCH == 'master' || $BRANCH == 'main' ]]; then 
+          echo "DEPLOYMENT_ENV=prod" >> "$GITHUB_ENV" 
+          echo "DEPLOYMENT_ROLE_ARN=$PROD_DEPLOYMENT_ROLE" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
+          echo "S3_BUCKET=$PROD_S3_BUCKET" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
+          echo "DEPLOYMENT_TAGS<<EOF" >> $GITHUB_ENV
+          echo $(<./tags.prod.json) >> $GITHUB_ENV
+          echo "EOF" >> $GITHUB_ENV
+         elif [[ $BRANCH == 'qa' ]]; then
+          echo "DEPLOYMENT_ENV=qa" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
+          echo "DEPLOYMENT_ROLE_ARN=$QA_DEPLOYMENT_ROLE" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
+          echo "S3_BUCKET=$QA_S3_BUCKET" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
+          echo "DEPLOYMENT_TAGS<<EOF" >> $GITHUB_ENV
+          echo $(<./tags.qa.json) >> $GITHUB_ENV
+          echo "EOF" >> $GITHUB_ENV
+         else 
+          echo "DEPLOYMENT_ENV=dev" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
+          echo "DEPLOYMENT_ROLE_ARN=$DEV_DEPLOYMENT_ROLE" >> "$GITHUB_ENV" 
+          echo "S3_BUCKET=$DEV_S3_BUCKET" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
+          echo "DEPLOYMENT_TAGS<<EOF" >> $GITHUB_ENV
+          echo $(<./tags.dev.json) >> $GITHUB_ENV
+          echo "EOF" >> $GITHUB_ENV
+         fi
+    - name: Configure credentials from AWS account using OIDC integration
+      uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@v1
+      with:
+        role-to-assume: ${{env.DEPLOYMENT_ROLE_ARN}}
+        aws-region: ${{ vars.AWS_REGION }}
+
+    - name: Setup Python
+      uses: actions/setup-python@v3
+      with:
+        python-version: "3.9"
+
+    - name: Pre-Building the Project
+      run: |
+        echo "done copying the functions file to each lambda function directory"
+
+    - name: Setup AWS SAM
+      uses: aws-actions/setup-sam@v2
+      
+    - name: Pre-Building the Project
+      run: |
+        echo "printing Environment ${{ env.DEPLOYMENT_ENV }}"
+  
+    - name: AWS SAM Build
+      run: sam build --use-container --template-file template.yml
+      
+    - name: sam package
+      run: sam package --template-file .aws-sam/build/template.yaml --s3-bucket ${{ env.S3_BUCKET }} --output-template-file template.yml --kms-key-id alias/aws/s3
+
+    - name: Upload CloudFormation Template to S3
+      run: |
+        aws s3 cp ./template.yml s3://${{ env.S3_BUCKET }}/${{ github.event.repository.name }}/template.yml    
+
+    - name: Deploy to AWS Cloudformation
+      uses: aws-actions/aws-cloudformation-github-deploy@v1
+      with: 
+        name: pipeline-${{ github.event.repository.name }}-deployment
+        template: https://s3.amazonaws.com/${{ env.S3_BUCKET }}/${{ github.event.repository.name }}/template.yml
+        parameter-overrides: file://${{ github.workspace }}/params.${{ env.DEPLOYMENT_ENV }}.json
+        changeset: --change-set-name
+        capabilities: CAPABILITY_IAM,CAPABILITY_AUTO_EXPAND, CAPABILITY_NAMED_IAM
+        no-fail-on-empty-changeset: "1"
+        tags: ${{ env.DEPLOYMENT_TAGS }}
+
+    - name: Copy configuration files and scripts to AWS S3
+      run: |
+        aws s3 cp ${{ github.workspace }}/functions/glue/mdids_ihub_clrm_to_cdts_conform.py s3://lly-edp-codeconfig-us-east-2-${{ env.DEPLOYMENT_ENV }}/mdids-infohub/CLRM_labsConnect/scripts/mdids_ihub_clrm_to_cdts_conform.py
+        aws s3 cp ${{ github.workspace }}/functions/glue/utils_abc_conform.py s3://lly-edp-codeconfig-us-east-2-${{ env.DEPLOYMENT_ENV }}/mdids-infohub/CLRM_labsConnect/utils/utils_abc_conform.py
+        aws s3 cp ${{ github.workspace }}/configs/${{ env.DEPLOYMENT_ENV }}/clrm_to_cdts_conform_config.json s3://lly-edp-codeconfig-us-east-2-${{ env.DEPLOYMENT_ENV }}/mdids-infohub/CLRM_labsConnect/configs/${{ env.DEPLOYMENT_ENV }}/clrm_to_cdts_conform_config.json

+AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
+Transform: 'AWS::Serverless-2016-10-31'
+Description: MDIDS CLRM Raw to Conform
+Parameters:
+  pGlueScriptRefinedtoConformLocation:
+      Type: String
+  pGlueRole:
+      Type: String
+  pSecurityGroup:
+      Type: "List<AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup::Id>"
+  pVpcSubnetID:
+      Type: String
+  pAvailabilityZone:
+      Type: String
+  pEnvironment:
+      Type: String
+  pSecretManagerConformName:
+      Type: String
+  pConfigBucket:
+      Type: String
+  pConfigKey:
+      Type: String
+  pABCBatchname:
+      Type: String
+  pABCJobname:
+      Type: String
+  pExtraPythonModules:
+      Type: String
+
+Resources:
+    
+    rGlueClrmToCdtsJobConform:
+        Type: AWS::Glue::Job
+        Properties:
+            Description: "Glue job for creating function to read labs connect data from refined bucket and load data to clinical results cluster"
+            GlueVersion: "3.0"
+            Command:
+                Name: glueetl
+                PythonVersion: 3
+                ScriptLocation: !Ref pGlueScriptRefinedtoConformLocation
+            Connections:
+                Connections:
+                    - !Ref rLabsConnectGlueConnection  
+            DefaultArguments: {
+                            "--job-bookmark-option": "job-bookmark-disable", 
+                            "--use-postgres-driver": "true",
+                            "--enable-continuous-cloudwatch-log": "true",
+                            "--enable-continuous-log-filter": "true",
+                            "--additional-python-modules":  "psycopg2-binary==2.8.6",
+                            "--extra-py-files": !Ref pExtraPythonModules,
+                            "--environment":!Sub "${pEnvironment}",
+                            "--configbucket":!Sub "${pConfigBucket}",
+                            "--configkey":!Sub "${pConfigKey}",
+                            "--ABCBatch":!Sub "${pABCBatchname}",
+                            "--ABCJob":!Sub "${pABCJobname}",
+                            "--dag_id": "None",
+            }
+            ExecutionProperty:
+                MaxConcurrentRuns: 100
+            MaxRetries: 0
+            Name: edb_mdids_ihub_clrm_to_cdts_conform
+            Role: !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/${pGlueRole}"
+            WorkerType: G.1X
+            NumberOfWorkers: 5
+            Timeout: 340
+
+    rLabsConnectGlueConnection:
+        Type: AWS::Glue::Connection
+        Properties:
+            CatalogId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
+            ConnectionInput:
+                Description: "MDIDS Labs Connect Glue Network Connection"
+                Name: "edb-mdids-ihub-labs-connect-connection-conform"
+                ConnectionType: "NETWORK"
+                PhysicalConnectionRequirements:
+                    SecurityGroupIdList: 
+                        Ref: pSecurityGroup
+                    SubnetId: !Ref pVpcSubnetID   
+                    AvailabilityZone: !Ref pAvailabilityZone
+    
+    rClinicalResultsLabsConnectSecret:
+        Type: AWS::SecretsManager::Secret
+        Properties:
+            Name: !Ref pSecretManagerConformName
+            Description: 'This is the secret for Labs Connect RDS instance in clinical results cluster'
+            SecretString: "{\"username\": \"\",\"host\": \"\",\"dbname\": \"\",\"password\": \"\",\"engine\": \"\",\"dbClusterIdentifier\": \"\",\"port\": \"\"}"
+
+

+name: Deploy cloudformation
+
+on: 
+  push:     
+    branches:
+      - dev
+      - develop
+      - qa
+      - main
+      - master
+      
+permissions: read-all
+jobs:
+  cloudformation-deploy:
+    name: Deploy Cloudformation
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    permissions:
+      id-token: write
+      contents: read
+
+    steps:
+    - name: Checkout
+      uses: actions/checkout@v2
+    
+    - name: cfn-lint-action
+      uses: ScottBrenner/cfn-lint-action@v2.2.9
+    
+    - name: Print the Cloud Formation Linter Version & run Linter.
+      run: |
+        cfn-lint --version
+        cfn-lint -t ./template.yml -i W3002
+        
+    - name: Set env BRANCH
+      run: echo "BRANCH=$(echo $GITHUB_REF | cut -d'/' -f 3)" >> $GITHUB_ENV
+    
+    - name: Set permissions for tags.dev.json
+      run: |
+        chmod +r ./tags.dev.json
+        chmod +r ./tags.qa.json
+        chmod +r ./tags.prod.json
+
+    - name: Set env DEPLOYMENT_ENV and DEPLOYMENT_ROLE_ARN and S3_BUCKET
+      env: 
+        DEV_DEPLOYMENT_ROLE: ${{ vars.DEPLOYMENT_ROLE_DEV }}
+        QA_DEPLOYMENT_ROLE: ${{ vars.DEPLOYMENT_ROLE_QA }}
+        PROD_DEPLOYMENT_ROLE: ${{ vars.DEPLOYMENT_ROLE_PROD }}
+        DEV_S3_BUCKET: ${{ vars.S3_BUCKET_DEV }}
+        QA_S3_BUCKET: ${{ vars.S3_BUCKET_QA }}
+        PROD_S3_BUCKET: ${{ vars.S3_BUCKET_PROD }}
+
+      run: |
+         if [[ $BRANCH == 'master' || $BRANCH == 'main' ]]; then 
+          echo "DEPLOYMENT_ENV=prod" >> "$GITHUB_ENV" 
+          echo "DEPLOYMENT_ROLE_ARN=$PROD_DEPLOYMENT_ROLE" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
+          echo "S3_BUCKET=$PROD_S3_BUCKET" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
+          echo "DEPLOYMENT_TAGS<<EOF" >> $GITHUB_ENV
+          echo $(<./tags.prod.json) >> $GITHUB_ENV
+          echo "EOF" >> $GITHUB_ENV
+         elif [[ $BRANCH == 'qa' ]]; then
+          echo "DEPLOYMENT_ENV=qa" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
+          echo "DEPLOYMENT_ROLE_ARN=$QA_DEPLOYMENT_ROLE" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
+          echo "S3_BUCKET=$QA_S3_BUCKET" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
+          echo "DEPLOYMENT_TAGS<<EOF" >> $GITHUB_ENV
+          echo $(<./tags.qa.json) >> $GITHUB_ENV
+          echo "EOF" >> $GITHUB_ENV
+         else 
+          echo "DEPLOYMENT_ENV=dev" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
+          echo "DEPLOYMENT_ROLE_ARN=$DEV_DEPLOYMENT_ROLE" >> "$GITHUB_ENV" 
+          echo "S3_BUCKET=$DEV_S3_BUCKET" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
+          echo "DEPLOYMENT_TAGS<<EOF" >> $GITHUB_ENV
+          echo $(<./tags.dev.json) >> $GITHUB_ENV
+          echo "EOF" >> $GITHUB_ENV
+         fi
+    - name: Configure credentials from AWS account using OIDC integration
+      uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@v1
+      with:
+        role-to-assume: ${{env.DEPLOYMENT_ROLE_ARN}}
+        aws-region: ${{ vars.AWS_REGION }}
+
+    - name: Setup Python
+      uses: actions/setup-python@v3
+      with:
+        python-version: "3.9"
+
+    - name: Pre-Building the Project
+      run: |
+        echo "done copying the functions file to each lambda function directory"
+
+    - name: Setup AWS SAM
+      uses: aws-actions/setup-sam@v2
+      
+    - name: Pre-Building the Project
+      run: |
+        echo "printing Environment ${{ env.DEPLOYMENT_ENV }}"
+  
+    - name: AWS SAM Build
+      run: sam build --use-container --template-file template.yml
+      
+    - name: sam package
+      run: sam package --template-file .aws-sam/build/template.yaml --s3-bucket ${{ env.S3_BUCKET }} --output-template-file template.yml --kms-key-id alias/aws/s3
+

+      run: |

+AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
+Transform: 'AWS::Serverless-2016-10-31'
+Description: MDIDS CLRM Raw to Refined
+Parameters:
+  AppName:
+      Type: String
+  CostCenter:
+      Type: String
+  CostCenterApprover:
+      Type: String
+  SystemOwner:
+      Type: String
+  SystemCustodian:
+      Type: String
+  PrimaryItContact:
+      Type: String
+  Level1BusinessArea:
+      Type: String
+  DataClassification:
+      Type: String
+      AllowedValues:
+          - "Green"
+          - "Yellow"
+          - "Orange"
+          - "Red"
+  Hipaa:
+      Type: String
+      AllowedValues:
+          - "Yes"
+          - "No"
+  pGlueScriptRawtoRefinedLocation:
+      Type: String 
+  pGlueScriptRefinedtoConformLocation:
+      Type: String
+  pGlueRole:
+      Type: String
+  pLabsMachineName:
+      Type: String
+  pStateMachineExecutionRoleName:
+      Type: String
+  pABCbatchlambdaname:
+      Type: String
+  pSnowlambdaname:
+      Type: String
+  pSecurityGroup:
+      Type: "List<AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup::Id>"
+  pVpcSubnetID:
+      Type: String
+  pAvailabilityZone:
+      Type: String
+  pCloudWatchRuleName:
+      Type: String
+  pCloudWatchRuleSchedule:
+      Type: String
+  pSecretManagerName:
+      Type: String
+
+Resources:
+    
+    GlueClrmToCdtsJobConform:
+        Type: AWS::Glue::Job
+        Properties:
+            Description: "Glue job for creating function to read labs connect data from refined bucket and load data to clinical results cluster"
+            GlueVersion: "3.0"
+            Command:
+                Name: glueetl
+                PythonVersion: 3
+                ScriptLocation: !Ref pGlueScriptRefinedtoConformLocation
+            Connections:
+                Connections:
+                    - !Ref rLabsConnectGlueConnection  
+            DefaultArguments: {
+                            "--job-bookmark-option": "job-bookmark-disable", 
+                            "--use-postgres-driver": "true",
+                            "--enable-continuous-cloudwatch-log": "true",
+                            "--enable-continuous-log-filter": "true",
+                            "--additional-python-modules":  "psycopg2-binary==2.8.6",
+                            "--dag_id": "None"
+            }
+            ExecutionProperty:
+                MaxConcurrentRuns: 100
+            MaxRetries: 0
+            Name: edb_mdids_ihub_clrm_to_cdts_conform
+            Role: !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/${pGlueRole}"
+            WorkerType: G.1X
+            NumberOfWorkers: 5
+            Timeout: 340
+
+    rLabsConnectGlueConnection:
+        Type: AWS::Glue::Connection
+        Properties:
+            CatalogId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
+            ConnectionInput:
+                Description: "MDIDS Labs Connect Glue Network Connection"
+                Name: "edb-mdids-ihub-labs-connect-connection-conform"
+                ConnectionType: "NETWORK"
+                PhysicalConnectionRequirements:
+                    SecurityGroupIdList: 
+                        Ref: pSecurityGroup
+                    SubnetId: !Ref pVpcSubnetID   
+                    AvailabilityZone: !Ref pAvailabilityZone
+              
+
+Outputs:
+    AppName:
+        Description: "The name of the deployed application. A derivative of the repo name"
+        Value: !Ref AppName
+    CostCenter:
+        Description: "CostCenter"
+        Value: !Ref CostCenter
+    CostCenterApprover:
+        Description: "CostCenterApprover"
+        Value: !Ref CostCenterApprover
+    SystemOwner:
+        Description: "SystemOwner"
+        Value: !Ref SystemOwner
+    SystemCustodian:
+        Description: "SystemCustodian"
+        Value: !Ref SystemCustodian
+    PrimaryItContact:
+        Description: "PrimaryItContact"
+        Value: !Ref PrimaryItContact
+    Level1BusinessArea:
+        Description: "Level1BusinessArea"
+        Value: !Ref Level1BusinessArea
+    DataClassification:
+        Description: "DataClassification"
+        Value: !Ref DataClassification
+    Hipaa:
+        Description: "Hipaa"
+        Value: !Ref Hipaa
