+name: Deploy cloudformation
+
+on: 
+  push:     
+    branches:
+      - dev
+      - develop
+      - qa
+      - main
+      - master
+      
+permissions: read-all
+jobs:
+  cloudformation-deploy:
+    name: Deploy Cloudformation
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    permissions:
+      id-token: write
+      contents: read
+
+    steps:
+    - name: Checkout
+      uses: actions/checkout@v2
+    
+    - name: cfn-lint-action
+      uses: ScottBrenner/cfn-lint-action@v2.2.9
+    
+    - name: Print the Cloud Formation Linter Version & run Linter.
+      run: |
+        cfn-lint --version
+        cfn-lint -t ./template.yml -i W3002
+        
+    - name: Set env BRANCH
+      run: echo "BRANCH=$(echo $GITHUB_REF | cut -d'/' -f 3)" >> $GITHUB_ENV
+    
+    - name: Set permissions for tags.dev.json
+      run: |
+        chmod +r ./tags.dev.json
+        chmod +r ./tags.qa.json
+        chmod +r ./tags.prod.json
+
+    - name: Set env DEPLOYMENT_ENV and DEPLOYMENT_ROLE_ARN and S3_BUCKET
+      env: 
+        DEV_DEPLOYMENT_ROLE: ${{ vars.DEPLOYMENT_ROLE_DEV }}
+        QA_DEPLOYMENT_ROLE: ${{ vars.DEPLOYMENT_ROLE_QA }}
+        PROD_DEPLOYMENT_ROLE: ${{ vars.DEPLOYMENT_ROLE_PROD }}
+        DEV_S3_BUCKET: ${{ vars.S3_BUCKET_DEV }}
+        QA_S3_BUCKET: ${{ vars.S3_BUCKET_QA }}
+        PROD_S3_BUCKET: ${{ vars.S3_BUCKET_PROD }}
+
+      run: |
+         if [[ $BRANCH == 'master' || $BRANCH == 'main' ]]; then 
+          echo "DEPLOYMENT_ENV=prod" >> "$GITHUB_ENV" 
+          echo "DEPLOYMENT_ROLE_ARN=$PROD_DEPLOYMENT_ROLE" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
+          echo "S3_BUCKET=$PROD_S3_BUCKET" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
+          echo "DEPLOYMENT_TAGS<<EOF" >> $GITHUB_ENV
+          echo $(<./tags.prod.json) >> $GITHUB_ENV
+          echo "EOF" >> $GITHUB_ENV
+         elif [[ $BRANCH == 'qa' ]]; then
+          echo "DEPLOYMENT_ENV=qa" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
+          echo "DEPLOYMENT_ROLE_ARN=$QA_DEPLOYMENT_ROLE" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
+          echo "S3_BUCKET=$QA_S3_BUCKET" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
+          echo "DEPLOYMENT_TAGS<<EOF" >> $GITHUB_ENV
+          echo $(<./tags.qa.json) >> $GITHUB_ENV
+          echo "EOF" >> $GITHUB_ENV
+         else 
+          echo "DEPLOYMENT_ENV=dev" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
+          echo "DEPLOYMENT_ROLE_ARN=$DEV_DEPLOYMENT_ROLE" >> "$GITHUB_ENV" 
+          echo "S3_BUCKET=$DEV_S3_BUCKET" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
+          echo "DEPLOYMENT_TAGS<<EOF" >> $GITHUB_ENV
+          echo $(<./tags.dev.json) >> $GITHUB_ENV
+          echo "EOF" >> $GITHUB_ENV
+         fi
+    - name: Configure credentials from AWS account using OIDC integration
+      uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@v1
+      with:
+        role-to-assume: ${{env.DEPLOYMENT_ROLE_ARN}}
+        aws-region: ${{ vars.AWS_REGION }}
+
+    - name: Setup Python
+      uses: actions/setup-python@v3
+      with:
+        python-version: "3.9"
+
+    - name: Pre-Building the Project
+      run: |
+        echo "done copying the functions file to each lambda function directory"
+
+    - name: Setup AWS SAM
+      uses: aws-actions/setup-sam@v2
+      
+    - name: Pre-Building the Project
+      run: |
+        echo "printing Environment ${{ env.DEPLOYMENT_ENV }}"
+  
+    - name: AWS SAM Build
+      run: sam build --use-container --template-file template.yml
+      
+    - name: sam package
+      run: sam package --template-file .aws-sam/build/template.yaml --s3-bucket ${{ env.S3_BUCKET }} --output-template-file template.yml --kms-key-id alias/aws/s3
+
+    - name: Upload CloudFormation Template to S3
+      run: |
+        aws s3 cp ./template.yml s3://${{ env.S3_BUCKET }}/${{ github.event.repository.name }}/template.yml    
+
+    - name: Deploy to AWS Cloudformation
+      uses: aws-actions/aws-cloudformation-github-deploy@v1
+      with: 
+        name: pipeline-${{ github.event.repository.name }}-deployment
+        template: https://s3.amazonaws.com/${{ env.S3_BUCKET }}/${{ github.event.repository.name }}/template.yml
+        parameter-overrides: file://${{ github.workspace }}/params.${{ env.DEPLOYMENT_ENV }}.json
+        changeset: --change-set-name
+        capabilities: CAPABILITY_IAM,CAPABILITY_AUTO_EXPAND, CAPABILITY_NAMED_IAM
+        no-fail-on-empty-changeset: "1"
+        tags: ${{ env.DEPLOYMENT_TAGS }}
+
+    - name: Copy configuration files and scripts to AWS S3
+      run: |
+        aws s3 cp ${{ github.workspace }}/functions/glue/mdids_ihub_clrm_to_cdts_conform.py s3://lly-edp-codeconfig-us-east-2-${{ env.DEPLOYMENT_ENV }}/mdids-infohub/CLRM_labsConnect/scripts/mdids_ihub_clrm_to_cdts_conform.py
+        aws s3 cp ${{ github.workspace }}/functions/glue/utils_abc_conform.py s3://lly-edp-codeconfig-us-east-2-${{ env.DEPLOYMENT_ENV }}/mdids-infohub/CLRM_labsConnect/utils/utils_abc_conform.py
+        aws s3 cp ${{ github.workspace }}/configs/${{ env.DEPLOYMENT_ENV }}/clrm_to_cdts_conform_config.json s3://lly-edp-codeconfig-us-east-2-${{ env.DEPLOYMENT_ENV }}/mdids-infohub/CLRM_labsConnect/configs/${{ env.DEPLOYMENT_ENV }}/clrm_to_cdts_conform_config.json

+AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
+Transform: 'AWS::Serverless-2016-10-31'
+Description: MDIDS CLRM Raw to Conform
+Parameters:
+  pGlueScriptRefinedtoConformLocation:
+      Type: String
+  pGlueRole:
+      Type: String
+  pSecurityGroup:
+      Type: "List<AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup::Id>"
+  pVpcSubnetID:
+      Type: String
+  pAvailabilityZone:
+      Type: String
+  pEnvironment:
+      Type: String
+  pSecretManagerConformName:
+      Type: String
+  pConfigBucket:
+      Type: String
+  pConfigKey:
+      Type: String
+  pABCBatchname:
+      Type: String
+  pABCJobname:
+      Type: String
+  pExtraPythonModules:
+      Type: String
+
+Resources:
+    
+    rGlueClrmToCdtsJobConform:
+        Type: AWS::Glue::Job
+        Properties:
+            Description: "Glue job for creating function to read labs connect data from refined bucket and load data to clinical results cluster"
+            GlueVersion: "3.0"
+            Command:
+                Name: glueetl
+                PythonVersion: 3
+                ScriptLocation: !Ref pGlueScriptRefinedtoConformLocation
+            Connections:
+                Connections:
+                    - !Ref rLabsConnectGlueConnection  
+            DefaultArguments: {
+                            "--job-bookmark-option": "job-bookmark-disable", 
+                            "--use-postgres-driver": "true",
+                            "--enable-continuous-cloudwatch-log": "true",
+                            "--enable-continuous-log-filter": "true",
+                            "--additional-python-modules":  "psycopg2-binary==2.8.6",
+                            "--extra-py-files": !Ref pExtraPythonModules,
+                            "--environment":!Sub "${pEnvironment}",
+                            "--configbucket":!Sub "${pConfigBucket}",
+                            "--configkey":!Sub "${pConfigKey}",
+                            "--ABCBatch":!Sub "${pABCBatchname}",
+                            "--ABCJob":!Sub "${pABCJobname}",
+                            "--enable-auto-scaling": true,
+                            "--dag_id": "None",
+            }
+            ExecutionProperty:
+                MaxConcurrentRuns: 100
+            MaxRetries: 0
+            Name: edb_mdids_ihub_clrm_to_cdts_conform
+            Role: !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/${pGlueRole}"
+            WorkerType: G.1X
+            NumberOfWorkers: 5
+            Timeout: 340
+
+    rLabsConnectGlueConnection:
+        Type: AWS::Glue::Connection
+        Properties:
+            CatalogId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
+            ConnectionInput:
+                Description: "MDIDS Labs Connect Glue Network Connection"
+                Name: "edb-mdids-ihub-labs-connect-connection-conform"
+                ConnectionType: "NETWORK"
+                PhysicalConnectionRequirements:
+                    SecurityGroupIdList: 
+                        Ref: pSecurityGroup
+                    SubnetId: !Ref pVpcSubnetID   
+                    AvailabilityZone: !Ref pAvailabilityZone
+    
+    rClinicalResultsLabsConnectSecret:
+        Type: AWS::SecretsManager::Secret
+        Properties:
+            Name: !Ref pSecretManagerConformName
+            Description: 'This is the secret for Labs Connect RDS instance in clinical results cluster'
+            SecretString: "{\"user\": \"\",\"host\": \"\",\"dbname\": \"\",\"password\": \"\",\"engine\": \"\",\"dbClusterIdentifier\": \"\",\"port\": \"\",\"driver\": \"\",\"glueConnectString\": \"\"}"
+

+name: Deploy cloudformation
+
+on: 
+  push:     
+    branches:
+      - dev
+      - develop
+      - qa
+      - main
+      - master
+      
+permissions: read-all
+jobs:
+  cloudformation-deploy:
+    name: Deploy Cloudformation
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    permissions:
+      id-token: write
+      contents: read
+
+    steps:
+    - name: Checkout
+      uses: actions/checkout@v2
+
+    - name: Setup Python
+      uses: actions/setup-python@v3
+      with:
+        python-version: "3.11"
+    
+    - name: cfn-lint-action
+      uses: ScottBrenner/cfn-lint-action@v2.2.9
+
+    - name: Install
+      run: |
+        echo "Installing Python code linting tool pylint"
+        pip install pylint
+
+    - name: Install python code dependencies
+      run: |
+        echo "Installing Python code dependencies"
+        for function_directory in $GITHUB_WORKSPACE/functions/* ; do
+          cd ${function_directory}
+          if [ -f "requirements.txt" ]; then
+            echo "  Installing dependencies for ${function_directory}"
+            pip install -r requirements.txt
+          fi
+        done
+
+    - name: Run Pylint
+      run: |
+        echo "Running pylint"
+        for function_directory in $GITHUB_WORKSPACE/functions/* ; do
+          cd $function_directory
+            echo "  Linting $function_directory"
+            pylint $function_directory/edb*.py
+          cd -
+        done
+    
+    - name: Print the Cloud Formation Linter Version & run Linter.
+      run: |
+        cfn-lint --version
+        cfn-lint --ignore-checks W3011 -t ./template.yml
+        
+    - name: Set env BRANCH
+      run: echo "BRANCH=$(echo $GITHUB_REF | cut -d'/' -f 3)" >> $GITHUB_ENV
+    
+    - name: Set permissions for tags.dev.json
+      run: |
+        chmod +r ./tags.dev.json
+        chmod +r ./tags.qa.json
+        chmod +r ./tags.prod.json
+
+    - name: Set env DEPLOYMENT_ENV and DEPLOYMENT_ROLE_ARN and S3_BUCKET
+      env: 
+        DEV_DEPLOYMENT_ROLE: ${{ vars.DEPLOYMENT_ROLE_DEV }}
+        QA_DEPLOYMENT_ROLE: ${{ vars.DEPLOYMENT_ROLE_QA }}
+        PROD_DEPLOYMENT_ROLE: ${{ vars.DEPLOYMENT_ROLE_PROD }}
+        DEV_S3_BUCKET: ${{ vars.S3_BUCKET_DEV }}
+        QA_S3_BUCKET: ${{ vars.S3_BUCKET_QA }}
+        PROD_S3_BUCKET: ${{ vars.S3_BUCKET_PROD }}
+
+      run: |
+         if [[ $BRANCH == 'master' || $BRANCH == 'main' ]]; then 
+          echo "DEPLOYMENT_ENV=prod" >> "$GITHUB_ENV" 
+          echo "DEPLOYMENT_ROLE_ARN=$PROD_DEPLOYMENT_ROLE" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
+          echo "S3_BUCKET=$PROD_S3_BUCKET" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
+          echo "DEPLOYMENT_TAGS<<EOF" >> $GITHUB_ENV
+          echo $(<./tags.prod.json) >> $GITHUB_ENV
+          echo "EOF" >> $GITHUB_ENV
+         elif [[ $BRANCH == 'qa' ]]; then
+          echo "DEPLOYMENT_ENV=qa" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
+          echo "DEPLOYMENT_ROLE_ARN=$QA_DEPLOYMENT_ROLE" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
+          echo "S3_BUCKET=$QA_S3_BUCKET" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
+          echo "DEPLOYMENT_TAGS<<EOF" >> $GITHUB_ENV
+          echo $(<./tags.qa.json) >> $GITHUB_ENV
+          echo "EOF" >> $GITHUB_ENV
+         else 
+          echo "DEPLOYMENT_ENV=dev" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
+          echo "DEPLOYMENT_ROLE_ARN=$DEV_DEPLOYMENT_ROLE" >> "$GITHUB_ENV" 
+          echo "S3_BUCKET=$DEV_S3_BUCKET" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
+          echo "DEPLOYMENT_TAGS<<EOF" >> $GITHUB_ENV
+          echo $(<./tags.dev.json) >> $GITHUB_ENV
+          echo "EOF" >> $GITHUB_ENV
+         fi
+
+    - name: Download_authenticators_template
+      run: |
+        echo "Copying Cirrus Authenticators template from S3"
+        aws s3 cp s3://lly-templates/cirrus/cloudformation/cirr-aws-authenticators/latest.yaml $GITHUB_WORKSPACE/codebuild-api-authenticators/authenticators.yaml
+
+
+    - name: Configure credentials from AWS account using OIDC integration
+      uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@v1
+      with:
+        role-to-assume: ${{env.DEPLOYMENT_ROLE_ARN}}
+        aws-region: ${{ vars.AWS_REGION }}
+
+    - name: Setup AWS SAM
+      uses: aws-actions/setup-sam@v2
+
+    - name: Run AWS SAM Build
+      run: sam build --use-container --template-file template.yml
+      
+    - name: sam package
+      run: sam package --template-file .aws-sam/build/template.yaml --s3-bucket ${{ env.S3_BUCKET }} --output-template-file template.yml --kms-key-id alias/aws/s3
+
+    - name: Deploy to AWS Cloudformation
+      uses: aws-actions/aws-cloudformation-github-deploy@v1
+      with: 
+        name: pipeline-${{ github.event.repository.name }}-deployment
+        template: ./template.yml
+        parameter-overrides: file://${{ github.workspace }}/params.${{ env.DEPLOYMENT_ENV }}.json
+        changeset: --change-set-name
+        capabilities: CAPABILITY_IAM,CAPABILITY_AUTO_EXPAND, CAPABILITY_NAMED_IAM
+        no-fail-on-empty-changeset: "1"
+        tags: ${{ env.DEPLOYMENT_TAGS }}

+++ b/template.yml
@@ -0,0 +1,123 @@
+AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
+Transform: 'AWS::Serverless-2016-10-31'
+
+Description: "This stack is used to add AWS Azure SSO App IAM Role Mapping"
+Parameters:
+  # Allows selecting different values based on the environment being deployed to
+  DeployEnvironment:
+    Type: String
+    AllowedValues:
+      - dev
+      - qa
+      - prod
+
+  pSG1:
+    Type: String
+
+  pSG2:
+    Type: String
+
+  pSUBNET1:
+    Type: String
+
+  pSUBNET2:
+    Type: String
+
+
+  pProductname:
+    Type: String
+    Default: "edb"
+
+  pLambdaServiceRole:
+    Description: EDB Core Lambda Service Role
+    Type: String
+
+  pAWSApplist:
+    Description: AWS Azure Application List
+    Type: String
+
+  pPythonLayer:
+    Description: Python Layer to be associated with Lambda function
+    Type: String
+
+Globals:
+  Function:
+    Timeout: 90
+
+Resources:
+
+  rEdbAzureAppRolesLogGroup:
+    Type: "AWS::Logs::LogGroup"
+    Properties:
+      LogGroupName: /aws/lambda/edb_aws_azuresso_approles_lambda
+
+  rEdbLambdaAddAwsAzureAppRoles:
+    Type: "AWS::Serverless::Function"
+    Properties:
+      Description: This function is used
+      CodeUri: functions/aws_azuresso_approles
+      FunctionName: edb_aws_azuresso_approles_lambda
+      Handler: edb_aws_azuresso_approles_lambda.lambda_handler
+      PermissionsBoundary: !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:policy/LZ-IAM-Boundary"
+      Runtime: python3.8
+      Timeout: 900
+      MemorySize: 512
+      Environment:
+        Variables:
+            default_timeout: 60
+            access_token_function_name: !Sub "${pProductname}-generate-bearer-token-${DeployEnvironment}"
+            filter:	displayName eq filterParam
+            graph_app_url_host: https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0
+            select: id
+            consistency_level: eventual
+            application_list: !Ref pAWSApplist
+      VpcConfig:
+          SubnetIds:
+              - !Ref pSUBNET1
+              - !Ref pSUBNET2
+          SecurityGroupIds:
+              - !Ref pSG1
+              - !Ref pSG2
+      Role: !Sub arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/${pLambdaServiceRole}
+    DependsOn:
+      - rEdbAzureAppRolesLogGroup
+
+  rBearerTokenSecret:
+    Type: AWS::SecretsManager::Secret
+    Properties:

@@ -0,0 +1,577 @@
+%YAML 1.1
+---
+AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
+
+Parameters:
+  ServiceName:
+    Type: String
+    Default: lusa-lilly-com-webapp
+    Description: The name of the ECS service.
+  ECRRepoName:
+    Type: String
+    Description: The name of the ECR service.
+  DeployEnvironment:
+    Type: String
+    AllowedValues:
+      - dev
+      - qa
+      - prod
+  DomainName:
+    Type: String
+    Description: Domain name for app
+  HostedZoneId:
+    Type: String
+    Description: Route 53 Hosted Zone ID for domain name
+  CostCenter:
+    Type: String
+    Description: ID of the cost center for this application
+  CostCenterApprover:
+    Type: String
+    Description: System ID of the cost center approver
+  SystemOwner:
+    Type: String
+    Description: System ID of the system owner
+  SystemCustodian:
+    Type: String
+    Description: System ID of the system custodian
+  PrimaryItContact:
+    Type: String
+    Description: System ID of the primary IT contact
+  Level1BusinessArea:
+    Type: String
+  DataClassification:
+    Type: String
+    AllowedValues:
+      - Green
+      - Yellow
+      - Orange
+      - Red
+      - TBD
+  Hipaa:
+    Type: String
+    AllowedValues:
+      - "Yes"
+      - "No"
+      - TBD
+    Description: Is app subject to HIPAA?
+  PrivateSubnets:
+    Type: CommaDelimitedList
+  ContainerCpu:
+    Type: Number
+    Default: 256
+    Description: How much CPU to give the container. 1024 is 1 CPU.
+  ContainerMemory:
+    Type: Number
+    Default: 512
+    Description: How much memory in megabytes to give the container.
+  ContainerPort:
+    Type: Number
+    Description: Which port to map from the task's container.
+  InitialTaskCount:
+    Type: Number
+    Default: 1
+    Description: How many tasks should the service initially start?
+  MaxTaskCount:
+    Type: Number
+    Default: 5
+    Description: How many tasks should autoscaling scale out to at most?
+  HealthCheckIntervalSeconds:
+    Type: Number
+    Default: 30
+    Description: The number of seconds between load balancer health checks on targets.
+  HealthCheckPath:
+    Type: String
+    Default: /
+    Description: The path the load balancer should use to check target health.
+  CPUScalingPercentage:
+    Type: Number
+    Default: 50
+    Description: Scale out when CPU utilization reaches this percentage.
+  RequestsPerMinuteScaling:
+    Type: Number
+    Default: 1000
+    Description: Scale out/in as number of requests per minute goes above/below this value.
+  ParentAlbStackName:
+    Type: String
+    Default: review-apps-alb
+    Description: Name of the stack that has the ALB for review apps
+  AlbHttpsPriority:
+    Type: Number
+    Description: Calculated priority to add the rule to the shared alb HTTPS listener
+
+Resources:
+  Cluster:
+    Type: AWS::ECS::Cluster
+    Properties:
+      Tags:
+        - Key: ProjectName
+          Value: !Ref ServiceName
+        - Key: Environment
+          Value: !Ref DeployEnvironment
+        - Key: CostCenter
+          Value: !Ref CostCenter
+        - Key: CostCenterApprover
+          Value: !Ref CostCenterApprover
+        - Key: SystemOwner
+          Value: !Ref SystemOwner
+        - Key: SystemCustodian
+          Value: !Ref SystemCustodian
+        - Key: PrimaryItContact
+          Value: !Ref PrimaryItContact
+        - Key: Level1BusinessArea
+          Value: !Ref Level1BusinessArea
+        - Key: DataClassification
+          Value: !Ref DataClassification
+        - Key: Hipaa
+          Value: !Ref Hipaa
+
+  ECSTaskExecutionRole:
+    # Enables the task's container to perform actions. Here, it allows:
+    #   - CloudWatch logs to be created and written to
+    #   - Read access to the SSM parameters for the app
+    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
+    Properties:
+      PermissionsBoundary: !Sub arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:policy/LZ-IAM-Boundary
+      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
+        Statement:
+          - Effect: Allow
+            Principal:
+              Service:
+                - ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
+            Action:
+              - sts:AssumeRole
+      Path: /
+      Policies:
+        - PolicyName: AmazonECSTaskExecutionRolePolicy
+          PolicyDocument:
+            Statement:
+              - Effect: Allow
+                Action:
+                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
+                  - logs:CreateLogStream
+                  - logs:PutLogEvents
+                  - ecr:*
+                Resource: "*"
+              - Effect: Allow
+                Action:
+                  - ssm:GetParameters
+                Resource: !Sub arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/${ServiceName}/*
+      Tags:
+        - Key: ProjectName
+          Value: !Ref ServiceName
+        - Key: Environment
+          Value: !Ref DeployEnvironment
+        - Key: CostCenter
+          Value: !Ref CostCenter
+        - Key: CostCenterApprover
+          Value: !Ref CostCenterApprover
+        - Key: SystemOwner
+          Value: !Ref SystemOwner
+        - Key: SystemCustodian
+          Value: !Ref SystemCustodian
+        - Key: PrimaryItContact
+          Value: !Ref PrimaryItContact
+        - Key: Level1BusinessArea
+          Value: !Ref Level1BusinessArea
+        - Key: DataClassification
+          Value: !Ref DataClassification
+        - Key: Hipaa
+          Value: !Ref Hipaa
+
+  ECSTaskRole:
+    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
+    Properties:
+      PermissionsBoundary: !Sub arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:policy/LZ-IAM-Boundary
+      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
+        Statement:
+          - Effect: Allow
+            Principal:
+              Service:
+                - ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
+            Action:
+              - sts:AssumeRole
+      Policies:
+        - PolicyName: AmazonECSTaskExecutionRolePolicy
+          PolicyDocument:
+            Statement:
+              - Effect: Allow
+                Action:
+                  - xray:PutTraceSegments
+                  - xray:PutTelemetryRecords
+                  - xray:GetSamplingRules
+                  - xray:GetSamplingTargets
+                  - xray:GetSamplingStatisticSummaries
+                Resource: "*"
+      Tags:
+        - Key: ProjectName
+          Value: !Ref ServiceName
+        - Key: Environment
+          Value: !Ref DeployEnvironment
+        - Key: CostCenter
+          Value: !Ref CostCenter
+        - Key: CostCenterApprover
+          Value: !Ref CostCenterApprover
+        - Key: SystemOwner
+          Value: !Ref SystemOwner
+        - Key: SystemCustodian
+          Value: !Ref SystemCustodian
+        - Key: PrimaryItContact
+          Value: !Ref PrimaryItContact
+        - Key: Level1BusinessArea
+          Value: !Ref Level1BusinessArea
+        - Key: DataClassification
+          Value: !Ref DataClassification
+        - Key: Hipaa
+          Value: !Ref Hipaa
+
+  WebTaskDefinition:
+    # Main "web" task
+    # Defines a task with the CPU, memory, and container image values passed in
+    # via parameters.
+    Type: AWS::ECS::TaskDefinition
+    Properties:
+      Family: !Ref ServiceName
+      Cpu: !Ref ContainerCpu
+      Memory: !Ref ContainerMemory
+      NetworkMode: awsvpc
+      RequiresCompatibilities:
+        - FARGATE
+      ContainerDefinitions:
+        - Name: !Ref ServiceName
+          Image:
+            !Join
+            - ""
+            - - !Ref AWS::AccountId
+              - .dkr.ecr.
+              - !Ref AWS::Region
+              - .amazonaws.com/
+              - !Ref ECRRepoName
+              - ":"
+              - IMAGE_TAG_PLACEHOLDER
+          PortMappings:
+            - ContainerPort: !Ref ContainerPort
+          LogConfiguration:
+            LogDriver: awslogs
+            Options:
+              awslogs-create-group: "true"
+              awslogs-region: !Ref AWS::Region
+              awslogs-group:
+                !Join
+                - ""
+                - - /aws/ecs/
+                  - !Ref Cluster
+              awslogs-stream-prefix: !Ref ServiceName
+          Environment:
+            - Name: NODE_ENV
+              Value: production
+            - Name: HOST
+              Value: !Ref DomainName
+          Secrets:
+            - Name: APP_BASE
+              ValueFrom: !Sub arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/${ServiceName}/APP_BASE
+            - Name: COOKIE_SIGN_KEY
+              ValueFrom: !Sub arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/${ServiceName}/COOKIE_SIGN_KEY
+            - Name: CSP_ENABLED
+              ValueFrom: !Sub arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/${ServiceName}/CSP_ENABLED
+            - Name: CSP_SKIP_BROWSER
+              ValueFrom: !Sub arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/${ServiceName}/CSP_SKIP_BROWSER
+            - Name: DEBUG
+              ValueFrom: !Sub arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/${ServiceName}/DEBUG
+            - Name: ERROR404_ENABLED
+              ValueFrom: !Sub arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/${ServiceName}/ERROR404_ENABLED
+            - Name: ERROR500_ENABLED
+              ValueFrom: !Sub arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/${ServiceName}/ERROR500_ENABLED
+            - Name: HELMET_CONTENTFUL_TOKEN
+              ValueFrom: !Sub arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/${ServiceName}/HELMET_CONTENTFUL_TOKEN
+            - Name: JF_ARTIFACTORY_AUTH
+              ValueFrom: !Sub arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/${ServiceName}/JF_ARTIFACTORY_AUTH
+            - Name: LKM_AZURE_AUTH_URL
+              ValueFrom: !Sub arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/${ServiceName}/LKM_AZURE_AUTH_URL
+            - Name: LKM_AZURE_CLIENTID
+              ValueFrom: !Sub arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/${ServiceName}/LKM_AZURE_CLIENTID
+            - Name: LKM_AZURE_CLIENT_SECRET
+              ValueFrom: !Sub arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/${ServiceName}/LKM_AZURE_CLIENT_SECRET
+            - Name: LKM_AZURE_GRANT_TYPE
+              ValueFrom: !Sub arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/${ServiceName}/LKM_AZURE_GRANT_TYPE
+            - Name: LKM_AZURE_SCOPE
+              ValueFrom: !Sub arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/${ServiceName}/LKM_AZURE_SCOPE
+            - Name: LKM_CLIENT_CERTIFICATE
+              ValueFrom: !Sub arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/${ServiceName}/LKM_CLIENT_CERTIFICATE
+            - Name: LKM_CLIENT_KEY
+              ValueFrom: !Sub arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/${ServiceName}/LKM_CLIENT_KEY
+            - Name: LKM_CLIENT_PASSPHRASE
+              ValueFrom: !Sub arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/${ServiceName}/LKM_CLIENT_PASSPHRASE
+            - Name: LKM_LANDINGZONE_ACCOUNTID
+              ValueFrom: !Sub arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/${ServiceName}/LKM_LANDINGZONE_ACCOUNTID
+            - Name: PREPROD_AUTH_ENABLED
+              ValueFrom: !Sub arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/${ServiceName}/PREPROD_AUTH_ENABLED
+      ExecutionRoleArn: !GetAtt ECSTaskExecutionRole.Arn
+      TaskRoleArn: !GetAtt ECSTaskRole.Arn
+      Tags:
+        - Key: ProjectName
+          Value: !Ref ServiceName
+        - Key: Environment
+          Value: !Ref DeployEnvironment
+        - Key: CostCenter
+          Value: !Ref CostCenter
+        - Key: CostCenterApprover
+          Value: !Ref CostCenterApprover
+        - Key: SystemOwner
+          Value: !Ref SystemOwner
+        - Key: SystemCustodian

+%YAML 1.1

+                  - cloudwatch:DescribeAlarms
+                  - cloudwatch:GetMetricStatistics
+                  - cloudwatch:SetAlarmState
+                  - cloudwatch:DeleteAlarms
+                Resource: "*"
+      Tags:
+        - Key: ProjectName
+          Value: !Ref ServiceName
+        - Key: Environment
+          Value: !Ref DeployEnvironment
+        - Key: CostCenter
+          Value: !Ref CostCenter
+        - Key: CostCenterApprover
+          Value: !Ref CostCenterApprover
+        - Key: SystemOwner
+          Value: !Ref SystemOwner
+        - Key: SystemCustodian
+          Value: !Ref SystemCustodian
+        - Key: PrimaryItContact
+          Value: !Ref PrimaryItContact
+        - Key: Level1BusinessArea
+          Value: !Ref Level1BusinessArea
+        - Key: DataClassification
+          Value: !Ref DataClassification
+        - Key: Hipaa
+          Value: !Ref Hipaa
+
+  AutoScalingTarget:
+    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
+    DependsOn: Service
+    Properties:
+      MaxCapacity: !Ref MaxTaskCount
+      MinCapacity: 0
+      ResourceId:
+        !Join
+        - /
+        - - service
+          - Fn::ImportValue: !Sub ${ParentStack}-ClusterName
+          - !Ref ServiceName
+      RoleARN: !GetAtt AutoScalingRole.Arn
+      ScalableDimension: ecs:service:DesiredCount
+      ServiceNamespace: ecs
+
+  CPUAutoScalingPolicy:
+    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
+    Properties:
+      PolicyName: CPUAutoScalingPolicy
+      PolicyType: TargetTrackingScaling
+      ScalingTargetId: !Ref AutoScalingTarget
+      TargetTrackingScalingPolicyConfiguration:
+        TargetValue: !Ref CPUScalingPercentage
+        ScaleInCooldown: 300
+        ScaleOutCooldown: 60
+        PredefinedMetricSpecification:
+          PredefinedMetricType: ECSServiceAverageCPUUtilization
+
+  RequestsAutoScalingPolicy:
+    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
+    Properties:
+      PolicyName: RequestsAutoScalingPolicy
+      PolicyType: StepScaling
+      ScalingTargetId: !Ref AutoScalingTarget
+      StepScalingPolicyConfiguration:
+        AdjustmentType: ChangeInCapacity
+        Cooldown: 60
+        MetricAggregationType: Average
+        StepAdjustments:
+          - MetricIntervalLowerBound: 0
+            ScalingAdjustment: 1
+          - MetricIntervalUpperBound: 0
+            ScalingAdjustment: -1
+
+  RequestsAlarm:
+    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
+    Properties:
+      MetricName: !Sub ${ServiceName}RequestCountPerTarget
+      Namespace: AWS/ApplicationELB
+      Statistic: Sum
+      Period: 60
+      EvaluationPeriods: 1
+      Threshold: !Ref RequestsPerMinuteScaling
+      AlarmActions:
+        - !Ref RequestsAutoScalingPolicy
+      OKActions:
+        - !Ref RequestsAutoScalingPolicy
+      Dimensions:
+        - Name: TargetGroup
+          Value: !GetAtt TargetGroup.TargetGroupFullName
+      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
+
+Outputs:
+  ServiceName:
+    Value: !Ref Service
+  ImageTag:
+    Value: IMAGE_TAG_PLACEHOLDER
\ No newline at end of file

@@ -0,0 +1,573 @@
+%YAML 1.1
+---
+AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
+
+Parameters:
+  ServiceName:
+    Type: String
+    Default: lusa-lilly-com-webapp
+    Description: The name of the ECS service.
+  ECRRepoName:
+    Type: String
+    Description: The name of the ECR service.
+  DeployEnvironment:
+    Type: String
+    AllowedValues:
+      - dev
+      - qa
+      - prod
+  DomainName:
+    Type: String
+    Description: Domain name for app
+  HostedZoneId:
+    Type: String
+    Description: Route 53 Hosted Zone ID for domain name
+  CostCenter:
+    Type: String
+    Description: ID of the cost center for this application
+  CostCenterApprover:
+    Type: String
+    Description: System ID of the cost center approver
+  SystemOwner:
+    Type: String
+    Description: System ID of the system owner
+  SystemCustodian:
+    Type: String
+    Description: System ID of the system custodian
+  PrimaryItContact:
+    Type: String
+    Description: System ID of the primary IT contact
+  Level1BusinessArea:
+    Type: String
+  DataClassification:
+    Type: String
+    AllowedValues:
+      - Green
+      - Yellow
+      - Orange
+      - Red
+      - TBD
+  Hipaa:
+    Type: String
+    AllowedValues:
+      - "Yes"
+      - "No"
+      - TBD
+    Description: Is app subject to HIPAA?
+  PrivateSubnets:
+    Type: CommaDelimitedList
+  ContainerCpu:
+    Type: Number
+    Default: 256
+    Description: How much CPU to give the container. 1024 is 1 CPU.
+  ContainerMemory:
+    Type: Number
+    Default: 512
+    Description: How much memory in megabytes to give the container.
+  ContainerPort:
+    Type: Number
+    Description: Which port to map from the task's container.
+  InitialTaskCount:
+    Type: Number
+    Default: 1
+    Description: How many tasks should the service initially start?
+  MaxTaskCount:
+    Type: Number
+    Default: 5
+    Description: How many tasks should autoscaling scale out to at most?
+  HealthCheckIntervalSeconds:
+    Type: Number
+    Default: 30
+    Description: The number of seconds between load balancer health checks on targets.
+  HealthCheckPath:
+    Type: String
+    Default: /
+    Description: The path the load balancer should use to check target health.
+  CPUScalingPercentage:
+    Type: Number
+    Default: 50
+    Description: Scale out when CPU utilization reaches this percentage.
+  RequestsPerMinuteScaling:
+    Type: Number
+    Default: 1000
+    Description: Scale out/in as number of requests per minute goes above/below this value.
+  ParentAlbStackName:
+    Type: String
+    Default: review-apps-alb
+    Description: Name of the stack that has the ALB for review apps
+  AlbHttpsPriority:
+    Type: Number
+    Description: Calculated priority to add the rule to the shared alb HTTPS listener
+
+Resources:
+  Cluster:
+    Type: AWS::ECS::Cluster
+    Properties:
+      Tags:
+        - Key: ProjectName
+          Value: !Ref ServiceName
+        - Key: Environment
+          Value: !Ref DeployEnvironment
+        - Key: CostCenter
+          Value: !Ref CostCenter
+        - Key: CostCenterApprover
+          Value: !Ref CostCenterApprover
+        - Key: SystemOwner
+          Value: !Ref SystemOwner
+        - Key: SystemCustodian
+          Value: !Ref SystemCustodian
+        - Key: PrimaryItContact
+          Value: !Ref PrimaryItContact
+        - Key: Level1BusinessArea
+          Value: !Ref Level1BusinessArea
+        - Key: DataClassification
+          Value: !Ref DataClassification
+        - Key: Hipaa
+          Value: !Ref Hipaa
+
+  ECSTaskExecutionRole:
+    # Enables the task's container to perform actions. Here, it allows:
+    #   - CloudWatch logs to be created and written to
+    #   - Read access to the SSM parameters for the app
+    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
+    Properties:
+      PermissionsBoundary: !Sub arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:policy/LZ-IAM-Boundary
+      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
+        Statement:
+          - Effect: Allow
+            Principal:
+              Service:
+                - ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
+            Action:
+              - sts:AssumeRole
+      Path: /
+      Policies:
+        - PolicyName: AmazonECSTaskExecutionRolePolicy
+          PolicyDocument:
+            Statement:
+              - Effect: Allow
+                Action:
+                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
+                  - logs:CreateLogStream
+                  - logs:PutLogEvents
+                  - ecr:*
+                Resource: "*"
+              - Effect: Allow
+                Action:
+                  - ssm:GetParameters
+                Resource: !Sub arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/${ServiceName}/*
+      Tags:
+        - Key: ProjectName
+          Value: !Ref ServiceName
+        - Key: Environment
+          Value: !Ref DeployEnvironment
+        - Key: CostCenter
+          Value: !Ref CostCenter
+        - Key: CostCenterApprover
+          Value: !Ref CostCenterApprover
+        - Key: SystemOwner
+          Value: !Ref SystemOwner
+        - Key: SystemCustodian
+          Value: !Ref SystemCustodian
+        - Key: PrimaryItContact
+          Value: !Ref PrimaryItContact
+        - Key: Level1BusinessArea
+          Value: !Ref Level1BusinessArea
+        - Key: DataClassification
+          Value: !Ref DataClassification
+        - Key: Hipaa
+          Value: !Ref Hipaa
+
+  ECSTaskRole:
+    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
+    Properties:
+      PermissionsBoundary: !Sub arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:policy/LZ-IAM-Boundary
+      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
+        Statement:
+          - Effect: Allow
+            Principal:
+              Service:
+                - ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
+            Action:
+              - sts:AssumeRole
+      Policies:
+        - PolicyName: AmazonECSTaskExecutionRolePolicy
+          PolicyDocument:
+            Statement:
+              - Effect: Allow
+                Action:
+                  - xray:PutTraceSegments
+                  - xray:PutTelemetryRecords
+                  - xray:GetSamplingRules
+                  - xray:GetSamplingTargets
+                  - xray:GetSamplingStatisticSummaries
+                Resource: "*"
+      Tags:
+        - Key: ProjectName
+          Value: !Ref ServiceName
+        - Key: Environment
+          Value: !Ref DeployEnvironment
+        - Key: CostCenter
+          Value: !Ref CostCenter
+        - Key: CostCenterApprover
+          Value: !Ref CostCenterApprover
+        - Key: SystemOwner
+          Value: !Ref SystemOwner
+        - Key: SystemCustodian
+          Value: !Ref SystemCustodian
+        - Key: PrimaryItContact
+          Value: !Ref PrimaryItContact
+        - Key: Level1BusinessArea
+          Value: !Ref Level1BusinessArea
+        - Key: DataClassification
+          Value: !Ref DataClassification
+        - Key: Hipaa
+          Value: !Ref Hipaa
+
+  WebTaskDefinition:
+    # Main "web" task
+    # Defines a task with the CPU, memory, and container image values passed in
+    # via parameters.
+    Type: AWS::ECS::TaskDefinition
+    Properties:
+      Family: !Ref ServiceName
+      Cpu: !Ref ContainerCpu
+      Memory: !Ref ContainerMemory
+      NetworkMode: awsvpc
+      RequiresCompatibilities:
+        - FARGATE
+      ContainerDefinitions:
+        - Name: !Ref ServiceName
+          Image:
+            !Join
+            - ""
+            - - !Ref AWS::AccountId
+              - .dkr.ecr.
+              - !Ref AWS::Region
+              - .amazonaws.com/
+              - !Ref ECRRepoName
+              - ":"
+              - IMAGE_TAG_PLACEHOLDER
+          PortMappings:
+            - ContainerPort: !Ref ContainerPort
+          LogConfiguration:
+            LogDriver: awslogs
+            Options:
+              awslogs-create-group: "true"
+              awslogs-region: !Ref AWS::Region
+              awslogs-group:
+                !Join
+                - ""
+                - - /aws/ecs/
+                  - !Ref Cluster
+              awslogs-stream-prefix: !Ref ServiceName
+          Environment:
+            - Name: NODE_ENV
+              Value: production
+            - Name: HOST
+              Value: !Ref DomainName
+          Secrets:
+            - Name: APP_BASE
+              ValueFrom: !Sub arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/${ServiceName}/APP_BASE
+            - Name: COOKIE_SIGN_KEY
+              ValueFrom: !Sub arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/${ServiceName}/COOKIE_SIGN_KEY
+            - Name: CSP_ENABLED
+              ValueFrom: !Sub arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/${ServiceName}/CSP_ENABLED
+            - Name: CSP_SKIP_BROWSER
+              ValueFrom: !Sub arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/${ServiceName}/CSP_SKIP_BROWSER
+            - Name: DEBUG
+              ValueFrom: !Sub arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/${ServiceName}/DEBUG
+            - Name: HELMET_CONTENTFUL_TOKEN
+              ValueFrom: !Sub arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/${ServiceName}/HELMET_CONTENTFUL_TOKEN
+            - Name: JF_ARTIFACTORY_AUTH
+              ValueFrom: !Sub arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/${ServiceName}/JF_ARTIFACTORY_AUTH
+            - Name: LKM_AZURE_AUTH_URL
+              ValueFrom: !Sub arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/${ServiceName}/LKM_AZURE_AUTH_URL
+            - Name: LKM_AZURE_CLIENTID
+              ValueFrom: !Sub arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/${ServiceName}/LKM_AZURE_CLIENTID
+            - Name: LKM_AZURE_CLIENT_SECRET
